        basis: "leave" as const,
        backupsClearAt: iso(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * HOUR),
        noticeHeld: block.tellHeld,
        releasedPosts: block.releasedPosts + params.postIds.length,
        releasedImages: block.releasedImages + 2 * params.postIds.length,
      };
      const custody = sealing.custody === undefined ? undefined : { ...sealing.custody, files: 0, moved: 0, movedAt: null, filesLeft: sealing.custody.moved };
      const answered = { ...view, decisions: view.decisions.map((decided) => (decided.id === sealing.id ? { ...decided, release: released, ...(custody === undefined ? {} : { custody }) } : decided)) };
      state.cases.set(caseId, answered);
      state.releases.push({ actionId, params });
      return { status: 201, body: answered };
    }
    if (gapClose) {
      if (state.role !== "admin") throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
      const input = parse(GapCloseBody, body, "POST /api/staff/restore/gaps/:gap/close");
      const id = gapClose[1]!;
      await confirmedOrder(input.stepUp, { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id }, params: { disposition: "not_needed" } } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      const gap = state.restore.gaps.find((found) => found.id === id && found.closedAt === null);
      if (gap === undefined) throw new Refusal(409, "gap_mismatch");
      state.restore = { ...state.restore, gaps: state.restore.gaps.map((found) => (found.id === id ? { ...found, closedAt: iso(Date.now()), disposition: "not_needed" } : found)) };
      state.gapsClosed.push(id);
      return { status: 201, body: state.restore };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signout") {
      state.sessions.delete(session.handle);
      return { status: 204, headers: { "set-cookie": CLEAR_COOKIES } };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/step-up/options") {
      const action = parse(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, body, key);
      const known =
        action.action === "identity_revealed"
          ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.items.some((item) => item.id === action.target.id))
          : action.action === "case_decided"
            ? state.cases.has(action.target.id)
            : action.action === "appeals_reviewed"
              ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.id === action.target.id))
              : action.action === "order_event_recorded" || action.action === "order_corrected" || action.action === "order_effected"
                ? state.orders.some((order) => order.id === action.target.id)
                : action.action === "audit_exported"
                  ? Number(action.target.id) <= Math.max(...state.audit.map((row) => row.seq))
                  : action.action === "gap_closed"
                    ? state.restore.gaps.some((gap) => gap.id === action.target.id)
                    : action.action === "seal_released"
                      ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === action.target.id)))
                      : action.action === "upload_hold_ended" || action.action === "upload_released"
                        ? state.uploads.some((upload) => upload.id === action.target.id)
                        : state.sessions.has(action.target.id);
      if (!known) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      // The page builds a reveal's or a decision's params from the digests it computed itself: one a save's answer carried never gets here.
      const decided = action.action === "case_decided" ? CaseDecidedParams.parse(action.params) : null;
      const underDigests = decided ? [decided.factsDigest, decided.reasonDigest, decided.legalReferenceDigest] : action.action === "identity_revealed" || action.action === "appeals_reviewed" ? [(action.params as { reasonDigest: string }).reasonDigest] : [];
      if (underDigests.some((digest) => typeof digest === "string" && state.forgedDigests.includes(digest))) problem(`${key}: an action under a digest the page did not compute`);
      state.stepUpOptionsServed += 1;
      // The mismatched case: an API that asks the key to confirm the revocation of this very session instead of the one
      // chosen; for a reveal, the reveal of another item than the one chosen; for a decision, the same decision on the
      // case's next version, which the page never saw.
      let bound: StaffStepUpActionInput = action;
      if (state.mismatchNextStepUp) {
        if (decided) bound = { action: "case_decided", target: action.target, params: { ...decided, stateVersion: decided.stateVersion + 1 } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        else if (action.action === "order_effected") {
          // 3f, Task 3: the effect of the same order with one more of its items than the page ticked.
          const params = action.params as { items: { itemId: string; postId: string }[] };
          const order = state.orders.find((found) => found.id === action.target.id);
          const extra = order?.items.find((item) => item.postId !== null && !params.items.some((one) => one.itemId === item.id));
          const items = extra ? [...params.items, { itemId: extra.id, postId: extra.postId! }].sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : a.postId > b.postId ? 1 : 0)) : params.items;
          bound = { ...action, params: { ...params, items } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        } else if (action.action === "upload_hold_ended") {
          // 3d Task 7: the other end of the same hold than the page chose.
          const params = action.params as UploadHoldEndedParams;
          bound = { ...action, params: params.endAs === "report" ? { endAs: "no_report", reason: "other" } : { endAs: "report", reason: null } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        } else if (action.action === "seal_released") {
          // 3d Task 2: the release of the same seal on the same leave, under another reference than the page showed.
          bound = { ...action, params: { ...(action.params as object), theirReference: "OTHER 9/99" } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        } else bound = { ...action, target: { ...action.target, id: action.action === "identity_revealed" ? randomUUID() : session.handle } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
      }
      state.mismatchNextStepUp = false;
      const challenge = await stepUpChallenge(session.handle, bound);
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "step_up", target: bound.target.id, hash: await stepUpActionHash(bound) });
      const allow = session.credentialId === null ? [] : [{ id: session.credentialId, type: "public-key", transports: ["usb"] }];
      return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: allow } } };
    }

    // DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle, confirmed by the session's own key for exactly this session.
    const handle = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice("/api/staff/sessions/".length));
    const { stepUp } = parse(StaffSessionRevokeRequest, body, "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle");
    const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
    if (issued.target !== handle || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
      problem(`DELETE ${handle}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}`);
      throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
    }
    const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
    if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_step_up_invalid" : refusal);
    if (!state.sessions.delete(handle)) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    state.revoked.push(handle);
    return { status: 204 };
  }

  /** The staff gate: the console's Host, an Origin on every write and never another, and same-origin fetch metadata. */
  function gate(req: IncomingMessage) {
    if (req.headers.host !== new URL(state.origin).host) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Host ${String(req.headers.host)}`);
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    const site = req.headers["sec-fetch-site"];
    if (site !== undefined && site !== "same-origin") {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Sec-Fetch-Site ${site}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
    const origin = req.headers.origin;
    if ((origin !== undefined || (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD")) && origin !== state.origin) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Origin ${String(origin)}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
  }

  /** Answers one request under /api/staff, as the API behind Caddy's console site would. */
  async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, url: URL, raw: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    let answer: Answer;
    try {
      if (state.off) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      gate(req);
      let body: unknown;
      if (raw.length > 0) {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8"));
        } catch {
          problem(`${req.method} ${url.pathname}: a body that is not JSON`);
          throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
        }
      }
      answer = await route(req, url, body);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof Refusal)) throw err;
      answer = { status: err.status, body: { error: { code: err.code, message: "the fixture's own words" } }, headers: err.headers };
    }
    state.requests.push({ method: req.method ?? "", path: `${url.pathname}${url.search}`, status: answer.status, activity: req.headers["x-staff-activity"] === "1" });
    const headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = { "cache-control": "no-store", ...answer.headers };
    if (answer.raw) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": answer.raw.type, "content-length": String(answer.raw.bytes.length) });
      res.end(answer.raw.bytes);
      return;
    }
    if (answer.body === undefined) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, headers);
      res.end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": "application/json" });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(answer.body));
  }

  return {
    state,
    handle,
    /** Every staff session ends behind the page's back, as a revocation from the command line ends them. */
    endEverySession() {
      state.sessions.clear();
    },
    /**
     * Another staff member decides the case behind the page: a withhold of the post taken while deciding, under rule R6,
     * on the case as it stands. The post is then withheld and the case's version moves on, so a decision the page built
     * on the version it read is answered case_changed.
     */
    decideBehindThePage(caseId: string): void {
      const found = state.cases.get(caseId);
      const [newest] = found?.snapshots ?? [];
      if (!found || !newest) throw new Error("the fixtures hold no such case, or it has no snapshot");
      const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse({
        kind: "interim",
        stateVersion: found.stateVersion,
        throughSeq: 0,
        reviewsDecisionId: null,
        snapshotId: newest.id,
        snapshotDigest: hex64(),
        outcome: "restricted",
        ground: "incompatible",
        ruleId: "R6",
        rulesVersion: 2,
        redressVersion: 1,
        category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6,
        categoryKeyword: null,
        actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }],
        factsDigest: hex64(),
        reasonDigest: hex64(),
        legalReferenceDigest: null,
        // 3e: every decision's params carry the marks and the withdrawal; this one sets neither.
        unfounded: [],
        replaced: false,
      });
      applyDecision(found, params, { facts: "The post repeats one link in every reply.", reason: "That is spam, which rule R6 names.", legalReference: null }, OTHER_STAFF);
      if (found.target.type === "post") found.target = { ...found.target, state: "withheld", level: "withheld" };
    },
    /** A new enrolment link, as `staff.js enroll` prints one for the person's next key; its token. */
    issueEnrolment(): string {
      state.enrolmentToken = b64url(32);
      state.enrolmentUsed = false;
      return state.enrolmentToken;
    },
  };
}

  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};
const page = (view: CaseView) => html(<CaseScreenView {...caseProps} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} />);

describe("a match's record on a case (8.4)", () => {
  test("[case.match] as label and value, the source's three strings framed and escaped, never a hash value; [case.matchWeak] by the hash type", () => {
    const out = page(matchCase(record({ hashType: "md5" })));
    const shown = text(out);
    const M = AUTOMATION_WORDS.match;
    for (const label of [M.source, M.listVersion, M.hashType, M.matchKind, M.classification, M.queriedAt]) expect(shown).toContain(label);
    // Each string a source wrote stands in a frame "As the source returned it", and none is markup or a link.
    expect(shown.split(M.frame).length - 1).toBe(3);
    expect(out).not.toContain('href="javascript:');
    expect(shown).toContain(LOOKALIKE.label);
    expect(shown).toContain(bothTimes(AT));
    expect(shown).toContain(M.weak("md5")!);
    expect(M.weak("md5")).toBe("A file with the same MD5 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files.");
    expect(M.weak("sha1")).toBe("A file with the same SHA-1 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files.");
    expect(M.weak("pdq")).toBe("A perceptual hash describes how a picture looks. Two different pictures can have the same one, by accident or on purpose.");
    expect(M.weak("sha256")).toBeNull();
    expect(text(page(matchCase(record())))).not.toContain("can be made on purpose");
    expect(shown).toContain(M.what);
    expect(shown).toContain("Source: Found by a program");
  });

  test("the three kinds: acting with [case.matchActing] and 3c's banner; listed and not exact with [case.matchNear] and the banner; another class with [case.matchFlag] and no banner", () => {
    const M = AUTOMATION_WORDS.match;
    const acting = text(page(matchCase(record())));
    expect(acting).toContain(M.acting);
    expect(acting).not.toContain(M.near);
    const near = text(page(matchCase(record({ matchKind: "near", acting: false }))));
    expect(near).toContain(M.near);
    expect(near).not.toContain(M.acting);
    const flag = page(matchCase(record({ listed: false, acting: false, classification: "other-class" })));
    expect(text(flag)).toContain(M.flag);
    expect(flag).not.toContain("banner suspect");
    expect(page(matchCase(record()))).toContain("banner suspect");
    expect(page(matchCase(record({ matchKind: "near", acting: false })))).toContain("banner suspect");
  });

  test("[case.image.matched] in the place of a matched image, with no reveal control, before an answer and after an answer without a seal; the other image is offered as before", () => {
    const before = page(matchCase(record()));
    expect(text(before)).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched);
    expect(before).not.toContain("Show image");
    // After an answer without a seal the images are served to everyone again: the matched one stays closed to staff.
    const after = page(matchCase(record(), { imagesAllowed: true, suspicion: null, items: [item({ id: ITEM_MATCH, source: SOURCES.program, explanation: null, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, ruleId: "R2", csam: true, suspect: true, outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: DECISION_SEAL })] }));
    expect(text(after)).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched);
    expect(after.split(">Show image<").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.image_matched).toBe(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched).toBe("Not opened: this image matched a list of known material. Nobody at korbat opens it, also after an answer without a seal.");
    void IMAGE_TWO;
  });

  test("a program's seal on a match: [case.auto] with the statement its author was sent, worded for a match, and [case.autoR2] while it is in force", () => {
    const sealing = decision({
      id: DECISION_SEAL,
      byProgram: true,
      staffHandle: null,
      source: "own_initiative",
      kind: "interim",
      ruleId: "R2",
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 4,
      suspect: true,
      decidedAt: AT,
      facts: null,
      reason: null,
      actions: [{ id: "3b4c5d6e-7f8a-4b9c-8d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e", kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] }, ...NO_STANDING }],
    });
    const view = matchCase(record({ source: "Example Hotline" }), { decisions: [sealing] });
    const shown = text(page(view));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR2);
    expect(shown).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.until.match);
    expect(shown).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askAdmin!);
    expect(statementParagraphs(programStatementOf(view, sealing))).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.notAssessed("csam", "exact"));
    const lifted = text(page(matchCase(record(), { decisions: [{ ...sealing, actions: sealing.actions.map((action) => ({ ...action, inForce: false })) }] })));
    expect(lifted).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR2);
  });
});

describe("the composer on a case a match opened (8.4)", () => {
  const draftOf = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], more: Partial<ReturnType<typeof newDraft>> = {}) => ({ ...newDraft(parseCaseId(view.id)!, view, role), ...more });
  const composer = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], more: Partial<ReturnType<typeof newDraft>> = {}) => {
    const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft: draftOf(view, role, more), now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
    return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
  };
  const answer = { kind: "final" as const, outcome: "no_violation" as const, actions: [] };

  test("an answer without a seal on an acting match asks for one of the reasons, none chosen; a match that does not act, and a seal, ask for none", () => {
    const view = matchCase(record());
    expect(answerReasonNeeded(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, answer))).toBe(true);
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, answer);
    for (const label of Object.values(MATCH_ANSWER_REASON_LABELS)) expect(text(out)).toContain(label);
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/name="compose-match-reason"[^>]*checked/);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.answerReason.choose);
    expect(answerReasonNeeded(matchCase(record({ matchKind: "near", acting: false })), draftOf(view, ADMIN, answer))).toBe(false);
    expect(answerReasonNeeded(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] }))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the key signs the reason only where it is asked for, and a decision without it is refused before any request", async () => {
    const view = matchCase(record());
    const digests = { snapshot: "a".repeat(64), facts: "b".repeat(64), reason: "c".repeat(64), legalReference: null };
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, { ...answer, matchAnswerReason: "source_withdrew" }), digests).matchAnswerReason).toBe("source_withdrew");
    // Elsewhere the member is absent, so every other decision's params hash as they did before Task 7.
    const plain = postCase();
    expect("matchAnswerReason" in decisionParamsOf(plain, draftOf(plain, ADMIN, { kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] }), digests)).toBe(false);
    let asked = 0;
    const api = new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => (asked++, Promise.reject(new Error("no request may be sent"))) });
    const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api: api as never, credentials: { get: () => Promise.reject(new Error("no key")) } as never }, parseCaseId(view.id)!, view, { ...draftOf(view, ADMIN, answer), written: { facts: "The record is the source's word.", reason: "", legal_reference: "", review_reason: "" } });
    expect(outcome).toEqual({ error: AUTOMATION_WORDS.answerReason.choose, code: "incomplete" });
    expect(asked).toBe(0);
  });

  test("[case.autoRecord] gains its second sentence for an admin who restricts on a match's finding citing R2, and the preview is partly automated", () => {
    const view = matchCase(record({ source: "Example Hotline" }));
    const seal = { kind: "final" as const, outcome: "restricted" as const, ruleId: "R2" as const, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null }] };
    expect(restrictsOnMatch(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, seal))).toBe(true);
    expect(text(composer(view, ADMIN, seal))).toContain(`${AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecord} ${AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecordPartly}`);
    expect(text(composer(view, ADMIN, answer))).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecordPartly);
    const preview = previewOf(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, seal), NOW);
    expect(preview).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "partially", signal: { kind: "known_match", source: "Example Hotline", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam" } });
    expect(statementParagraphs(preview).join(" ")).toContain("this decision rests on them in part");
    // A flag of another class is never partly automated: it cites no rule.
    const flag = matchCase(record({ listed: false, acting: false }));
    expect(restrictsOnMatch(flag, draftOf(flag, ADMIN, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] }))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("[case.liftedMatch] in the place of 3c's sentence on a case that holds a match; the seal's facts draft is W.3's comparison about this post", () => {
    const view = matchCase(record({ source: "Example Hotline" }));
    const shown = text(composer(view, ADMIN, answer));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.liftedMatch);
    expect(shown).not.toContain("whoever is on duty opens the case's target the same day");
    expect(text(composer(frozenCase(), ADMIN, answer))).toContain("whoever is on duty opens the case's target the same day");
    const facts = matchSealFacts(view)!;
    expect(facts).toBe(
      "An automated comparison found that an image of this post has the same fingerprint as one that Example Hotline has classified as child sexual abuse material. korbat's staff do not open such an image, and korbat has not assessed it.",
    );
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.match_post).toContain("{comparison}");
    expect(sealDraftFor(view, "final").facts).toBe(facts);
    // A case with a person's report of such material keeps 3c's draft.
    expect(matchSealFacts(frozenCase({ signals: [] }))).toBeNull();
    void CASE_FROZEN;
  });
});

    expect(text(out)).toContain(W.what);

    expect(text(html(<UploadsView rows={{ state: "ready", value: [] }} more={false} loadingMore={false} onLoadMore={noop} actions={actions(ADMIN)} />))).toContain(W.empty);
  });

### Replace `apps/admin/test/readme.test.ts` (whole file)

````ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_RULES, ALERT_TEXTS, AUTOMATION_RULES, EDGE_CACHE, EDGE_RULES, HEAD_RULES, ORDER_RULES, RECIPIENT_RULES, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RETENTION, SIGNAL_RULES, STANDING_RULES, TRANSPARENCY_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK, RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK } from "../src/screens/Home";

/**
 * The README's moderation runbook and the console's home screen say the same thing (3c design, section 13, Task 12).
 * When decided items wait for the daily release longer than it ever takes, or an erasure is more than a day late, the
 * home screen shows the count with the runbook's sentence for it, and each sentence is a constant of the screen. This
 * test reads README.md from the repository's root and holds the runbook to the same two constants, word for word, so
 * that what staff are told on the screen is what the operator reads in the runbook: whoever changes one changes both.
 */
const README = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "..", "README.md");

/** Markdown's code mark. The README sets a log line or a setting in code marks; the console shows the same words as plain text. */
const CODE_MARK = "`";

/** A text as its reader sees it: without the code marks. Nothing else is changed, so every word and every sign must agree. */
const withoutCodeMarks = (text: string): string => text.split(CODE_MARK).join("");

/** The README's lines, as written. */
function readmeLines(): string[] {
  return readFileSync(README, "utf8").split("\n");
}

/** The lines of the README's section "Moderation": from its heading to the next heading of the same level. */
function moderationSection(): string[] {
  const lines = readmeLines();
  const start = lines.indexOf("## Moderation");
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}

/** The section's runbook as its reader sees it: every line after "The runbook:", without the code marks. */
function moderationRunbook(): string {
  const section = moderationSection();
  const start = section.indexOf("The runbook:");
  return start === -1 ? "" : withoutCodeMarks(section.slice(start + 1).join("\n"));
}

/** How often `part` stands in `text`. */
const count = (text: string, part: string): number => text.split(part).length - 1;

describe("the README's moderation runbook says what the home screen says", () => {
  const sentences: [string, string][] = [
    ["decisions not released", RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK],
    ["late erasures", ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK],
  ];

  test("the README has a section Moderation, and the section has a runbook", () => {
    expect(readmeLines()).toContain("## Moderation");
    expect(moderationSection()).toContain("The runbook:");
    expect(moderationRunbook().trim()).not.toBe("");
  });

  test("neither constant holds a code mark or a line break, so reading the README without its code marks hides no difference", () => {
    for (const [name, sentence] of sentences) {
      expect(sentence, name).not.toContain(CODE_MARK);
      expect(sentence, name).not.toContain("\n");
      // A whole sentence: it opens with "A count of" and ends in a full stop, as the runbook's bullet writes it.
      expect(sentence.startsWith("A count of "), name).toBe(true);
      expect(sentence.endsWith("."), name).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  for (const [name, sentence] of sentences) {
    test(`the runbook holds the home screen's sentence for ${name}, word for word`, () => {
      expect(moderationRunbook()).toContain(sentence);
    });

    test(`the sentence for ${name} stands once in the README, in that runbook: no second copy can drift from it`, () => {
      expect(count(withoutCodeMarks(readmeLines().join("\n")), sentence)).toBe(1);
      expect(count(moderationRunbook(), sentence)).toBe(1);
    });
  }

  test("both sentences stand in one bullet of the runbook, the release's first, as the home screen orders its two lines", () => {
    const bullets = moderationRunbook()
      .split("\n")
      .filter((line) => line.includes(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK) || line.includes(ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK));
    expect(bullets).toHaveLength(1);
    const bullet = bullets[0] ?? "";
    expect(bullet.startsWith("- ")).toBe(true);
    expect(bullet.indexOf(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK)).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(bullet.indexOf(ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK)).toBeGreaterThan(bullet.indexOf(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK));
  });
});

/**
 * The README's account sanctions (3e design, section 13, Task 7) and the constants they print. The section Moderation
 * describes 3e in a paragraph that opens with ACCOUNT_SANCTIONS_LEAD and a bullet for each title below, and its runbook
 * gains the bullets of section 13's (a) to (h). Every number in that text is a number of STANDING_RULES or
 * REPLY_AIM_HOURS: a table holds each in its sentence, and every other run of digits is refused, so the README cannot
 * keep a number the constants changed. A bullet added to 3e's text joins its list here.
 */
const ACCOUNT_SANCTIONS_LEAD = "Account sanctions (sub-project 3e;";
const STANDING_TITLES = [
  "Strikes.",
  "The ladder.",
  "Announced suspensions and the reply.",
  "Suspensions at once.",
  "While suspended.",
  "Termination.",
  "The restriction of reporting.",
  "Handle retirement.",
  "What is kept of them.",
  "The Standing screen.",
  // The runbook's bullets (a) to (h).
  "Account sanctions each working day.",
  "Answering a reply.",
  "A protective suspension.",
  "A breach that lies only in a handle",
  "A notice a person did not get by mail.",
  "A measure at once while an announced suspension waits.",
  "A mark that was wrong.",
  "Reports before an account measure.",
] as const;

/** The lines of 3e's text in Moderation, without code marks: the lead paragraph and each bullet by its bold title. */
function standingLines(): { lead: string | undefined; bullets: Map<string, string[]> } {
  const section = moderationSection().map(withoutCodeMarks);
  const bullets = new Map(STANDING_TITLES.map((title) => [title as string, section.filter((line) => line.startsWith(`- **${title}`))]));
  return { lead: section.find((line) => line.startsWith(ACCOUNT_SANCTIONS_LEAD)), bullets };
}
const standingText = (): string => {
  const { lead, bullets } = standingLines();
  return [lead ?? "", ...[...bullets.values()].flat()].join("\n");
};

/** A number in a sentence as the README writes it, and the constant it is. */
const S = STANDING_RULES;
const STANDING_NUMBERS: { constant: string; phrase: string }[] = [

  { constant: "ladderMemoryDays", phrase: `the ladder suspensions decided in the last ${S.ladderMemoryDays} days` },
  { constant: "replyWindowHours", phrase: `The suspension starts ${S.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat's relay accepted the notice mail` },
  { constant: "undeliveredHours", phrase: `or ${S.undeliveredHours} hours after the decision` },
  { constant: "threatDays", phrase: `(up to ${S.threatDays} days), terrorist content` },
  { constant: "terroristDays", phrase: `likewise (up to ${S.terroristDays} days)` },
  { constant: "floodPosts", phrase: `at least ${S.floodPosts} posts in the last` },
  { constant: "floodMinutes", phrase: `posts in the last ${S.floodMinutes} minutes` },
  { constant: "floodDays", phrase: `minutes (up to ${S.floodDays} days)` },
  { constant: "basisAgeDays", phrase: `at most ${S.basisAgeDays} days old` },
  { constant: "protectiveDays", phrase: `once for that seal (up to ${S.protectiveDays} days)` },
  { constant: "protectiveDays", phrase: `for at most ${S.protectiveDays} days, never worded as a finding` },
  { constant: "reportWarnMarks", phrase: `At least ${S.reportWarnMarks} marked reports in ${S.reportFrameDays} days` },
  { constant: "reportRestrictMarks", phrase: `${S.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports sent after it, while it counts (${S.reportFrameDays} days)` },
  { constant: "reportRestrictDays", phrase: `open a restriction of at most ${S.reportRestrictDays} days` },
  { constant: "reportFrameDays", phrase: `the marks and the daily tallies ${S.reportFrameDays} days after their report's UTC day` },
  { constant: "REPLY_AIM_HOURS", phrase: `korbat aims to answer a reply to one within ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours` },
  { constant: "REPLY_AIM_HOURS", phrase: `answer within ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours` },
];

describe("the README's account sanctions say what the constants say (3e design, section 13, Task 7)", () => {
  test("Moderation opens 3e's part with its paragraph, and each of its bullets stands there once", () => {
    const { lead, bullets } = standingLines();
    expect(lead).toBeDefined();

    for (const title of STANDING_TITLES.slice(STANDING_TITLES.indexOf("Account sanctions each working day."))) expect(runbook.some((line) => line.startsWith(`- **${title}`)), title).toBe(true);
  });

  test("every number of 3e's text stands in its sentence with the constant's value", () => {
    const text = standingText();
    for (const row of STANDING_NUMBERS) expect(text, `${row.constant}: ${row.phrase}`).toContain(row.phrase);
    // The table names every member of STANDING_RULES but the share, which the text writes as a word.
    expect([...new Set(STANDING_NUMBERS.map((row) => row.constant))].sort()).toEqual([...Object.keys(S).filter((key) => key !== "reportWarnShare"), "REPLY_AIM_HOURS"].sort());

  test("and no other number: every run of digits in it is a constant's, outside the names of sub-projects, rules, articles and the design's file", () => {

    const outside = standingText()
      .replace(/docs\/superpowers\/specs\/[0-9a-z-]+\.md/g, " ")
      .replace(/\b[0-9][a-f]\b/g, " ")
      .replace(/\bR[1-6]\b/g, " ")
      .replace(/Art\. [0-9]+(\([0-9]+\))?(\([a-z]\))?/g, " ");
    expect((outside.match(/[0-9]+/g) ?? []).filter((digits) => !values.has(digits))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the lines 3e made false are gone: the handle left open for 3e, formula version 1 and the mails that name 3e", () => {
    const all = readmeLines().join("\n");
    expect(all).not.toContain("the case stays open for sub-project 3e's handle retirement");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Until sub-project 3e's formula version 2");
    expect(all).not.toContain("EXPLORE_V1");
    expect(all).not.toContain("still names sub-project 3e");
    // The hard gate names 3f's order path and 3d's handling of sealed images, as it did since 3e's design; since 3d Task 2
    // in W.11's words, its quarantine and release.
    expect(all).toContain("until sub-project 3f's order path and sub-project 3d's quarantine and release have shipped");

/**
 * The README's authorities' orders (3f design, section 13, Task 7; W.9 and W.10) and the constants they print. 3f's text
 * is the section "Authorities' orders", Upgrading from its 3f paragraph on (Task 1), Restoring's block "Restoring with
 * the keeper's copy" (Task 6) and Before going public's owner's list. Every number in it is a number of ORDER_RULES or
 * ALERT_RULES: a table holds each in its sentence, and every other run of digits is refused but for what names a
 * reference (an article, a research finding, a row of the design's section 2, a check P1 to P8, a list's numbering, a
 * path, a date), so the README cannot keep a number the constants changed. A setting is written as the operator sets it
 * in infra/.env, an API setting with the prefix Compose maps. A section added to 3f's text joins its list here.
 */
const FENCE = "```";

/** The lines of a "## " section of the README, from its heading to the next heading of the same level. */
function sectionLines(heading: string): string[] {
  const lines = readmeLines();
  const start = lines.indexOf(heading);
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}
/** A section's lines from the first that begins with these words to the section's end, or to the first that begins with `until`. */
function linesFrom(lines: string[], lead: string, until?: string): string[] {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(lead));
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start);
  const end = until === undefined ? -1 : rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(until));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}
/** Lines without their fenced code: a command's own numbers and words are not the runbook's. */
function withoutFences(lines: string[]): string[] {
  let inside = false;
  return lines.filter((line) => {
    if (line.startsWith(FENCE)) {
      inside = !inside;
      return false;
    }
    return !inside;
  });
}

const ORDERS_HEADING = "## Authorities' orders";
const ORDERS_TITLES = [
  "The contact point.",
  "On call.",
  "A removal order, step by step",
  "Other messages and orders.",
  "When nobody can act within the hour.",
  "Notifications and hand-overs.",
  "A person asks about a missing post.",
  "An author writes about an order's notice.",
  "The daily copy.",
  "A key in someone else's hands.",
  "The yearly counts.",
] as const;
const OWNERS_LEAD = "**The owner's list (sub-project 3f).**";
const OWNERS_TITLES = [
  "The Member State.",
  "The mailbox.",
  "The people's own access to the mailbox.",
  "Registering.",
  "The push hostname and ntfy's users.",
  "The phones.",
  "The keys.",
  "The papers, and counsel.",
  "The contact address.",
  "The page for the yearly report.",
  "The keeper, and the two places files rest.",
  "Decide",
  "Counsel",
] as const;

/** 3f's text, part by part, without code marks and fenced code. */
function ordersParts(): Record<"orders" | "upgrading" | "restoring" | "owners", string> {
  const read = (lines: string[]) => withoutCodeMarks(withoutFences(lines).join("\n"));
  return {
    orders: read(sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING)),
    upgrading: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Upgrading"), "Authorities' orders and the alert channel (sub-project 3f)")),
    restoring: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Restoring"), "**Restoring with the keeper's copy**")),
    owners: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Before going public"), OWNERS_LEAD, "Set these in")),
  };
}
const ordersText = (): string => Object.values(ordersParts()).join("\n");

/** A number in a sentence as the README writes it, and the constant it is. */
const O = ORDER_RULES;
const A = ALERT_RULES;
const ORDER_NUMBERS: { constant: string; part: keyof ReturnType<typeof ordersParts>; phrase: string }[] = [
  { constant: "ALERT_RULES.pollSeconds", part: "orders", phrase: `reads the inbox and the junk folder every ${A.pollSeconds} seconds` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes", part: "orders", phrase: `it rings every staff phone ${O.escalateMinutes} minutes after its arrival` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction", part: "orders", phrase: `one key touch for up to ${O.itemsPerAction} posts` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays", part: "orders", phrase: `alerted daily in the last ${O.holdWarningDays} days before any release` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays", part: "orders", phrase: `the address is kept for at most ${O.reportHoldDays} days` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays", part: "upgrading", phrase: `keeps its address, and nothing else, for at most ${O.reportHoldDays} days` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.copyOverdueHours", part: "orders", phrase: `once the newest copy is more than ${O.copyOverdueHours} hours old` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes", part: "owners", phrase: `bounded only by the quiet period of ${O.quietMinutes} minutes` },
];

/** What names a reference and is no number of the runbook's, taken out before the digits are counted; only the second keeps a group, the character before the name. */
const REFERENCES: RegExp[] = [
  // A path, a file or a regulation's number: whatever holds a slash.
  /[A-Za-z0-9_.()-]*[/][A-Za-z0-9_./-]+/g,
  // A sub-project's name (3f, 3d, 1b) and a phone check (P1 to P8).
  /(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])([0-9][a-f]|P[1-8])(?=[^0-9A-Za-z]|$)/gm,
  // A list's numbering.
  /^[0-9]+[.] /gm,
  // An article of an act, with its paragraphs.
  /Art(?:icle|[.]) [0-9]+(?:[(][0-9a-z]+[)])*/g,
  // A finding of the research, with its questions; a row of the design's section 2, and the section itself.
  /(?:OL|AU) E[0-9]+[.][0-9]+(?: questions [0-9]+ to [0-9]+)?/g,
  /[(]rows? [0-9]+(?: and [0-9]+)?[)]/g,
  /section [0-9]+/g,
  // A step of a list named in a sentence.
  /steps? [0-9]+/g,
  // An instant as an example of the form, a date of the year, the hand-over's user, a hash's name, a status's code.
  /[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:]+Z/g,
  /[0-9]+ March/g,
  /uid [0-9]+/g,
  /sha256/g,
  /answers 503/g,
];

describe("the README's authorities' orders say what the constants say (3f design, section 13, Task 7; W.9 and W.10)", () => {
  test("the README has the section Authorities' orders after Moderation, and each of its parts stands there once, in W.9's order", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    expect(lines.indexOf(ORDERS_HEADING)).toBeGreaterThan(lines.indexOf("## Moderation"));
    const section = sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING).map(withoutCodeMarks);
    const at = ORDERS_TITLES.map((title) => section.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(`**${title}`)));
    for (const title of ORDERS_TITLES) expect(section.filter((line) => line.startsWith(`**${title}`)), title).toHaveLength(1);
    expect([...at].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual(at);
  });

  test("Before going public holds the owner's list of thirteen, each line by its title, in W.10's order", () => {
    const owners = linesFrom(sectionLines("## Before going public"), OWNERS_LEAD, "Set these in").filter((line) => /^[0-9]+[.] /.test(line));
    expect(owners.map((line) => line.slice(0, line.indexOf(" ")))).toEqual(OWNERS_TITLES.map((_, n) => `${n + 1}.`));
    for (const [n, title] of OWNERS_TITLES.entries()) expect(owners[n]!.startsWith(`${n + 1}. **${title}`), title).toBe(true);
  });

  test("every number of 3f's text stands in its sentence with the constant's value", () => {
    const parts = ordersParts();
    for (const row of ORDER_NUMBERS) expect(parts[row.part], `${row.constant}: ${row.phrase}`).toContain(row.phrase);
  });

  test("and no other number: every run of digits in it is a constant's, outside what names a reference", () => {
    const values = new Set<string>([...Object.values(O), ...Object.values(A)].filter((value) => typeof value === "number").map(String));
    const outside = REFERENCES.reduce((text, pattern) => text.replace(pattern, (_match: string, lead: unknown) => (typeof lead === "string" ? `${lead} ` : " ")), ordersText());
    expect((outside.match(/[0-9]+/g) ?? []).filter((digits) => !values.has(digits))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a setting is written as the operator sets it in infra/.env: an API setting with its prefix", () => {
    const withMarks = [sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING), linesFrom(sectionLines("## Upgrading"), "Authorities' orders and the alert channel"), linesFrom(sectionLines("## Restoring"), "**Restoring with the keeper's copy**")]
      .flatMap((lines) => withoutFences(lines))
      .join("\n");
    for (const name of ["NOTIFY", "REPORT_HOLD", "MODERATION_RETENTION", "HOME_STATE", "CONTACT_POINT", "PUSH_ORIGIN", "APP_ORIGIN"]) {
      expect(withMarks.includes(`${CODE_MARK}${name}`), name).toBe(false);
    }
    for (const name of ["API_CONTACT_POINT", "API_HOME_STATE", "API_REPORT_HOLD", "API_MODERATION_RETENTION", "APP_SITE", "COMPOSE_PROFILES", "WEB_CONTACT_POINT", "WEB_HOME_STATE"]) {
      expect(withMarks.includes(name) || ordersText().includes(name), name).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  test("the hand-over's and the yearly counts' commands stand in the runbook as the operator types them", () => {
    const orders = ordersParts().orders;
    for (const words of [
      "docker compose --profile handover run --rm -T -v <directory>:/handover handover < list > digests",
      "handover-list",
      "handover-record",
      "handover-destroyed",
      "staff.js tco-counts <last year>",
      "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js address-check --handle <handle> < address",
    ]) {
      expect(orders, words).toContain(words);
    }
    expect(readmeLines().join("\n")).toContain("docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm migrate node dist/staff.js tco-counts <year>");
  });

  test("3f's review: a sentence of Restoring or of the orders' runbook that sets APP_SITE recreates Caddy alone, and one that sets an API switch names the start that reads it", () => {
    // Caddy reads APP_SITE only when its container is created, and the API reads its switches only at its start: a
    // setting in infra/.env alone changes nothing. Without --no-deps Compose would start the API with Caddy.
    const sentences = [...sectionLines("## Restoring"), ...sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING)].flatMap((line) => line.split(/(?<=[.;])\s+(?=[A-Z`(])/));
    const site = sentences.filter((sentence) => sentence.includes("`APP_SITE="));
    const api = sentences.filter((sentence) => /`API_[A-Z_]+=/.test(sentence));
    expect(site.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(api.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    for (const sentence of site) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d --no-deps caddy");
    for (const sentence of api) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d api");
    // operations5: a message moved between the two folders is a second row; the runbook says not to, and what then.
    expect(ordersParts().orders).toContain("Never move a message between the inbox and the junk folder");
    expect(ordersParts().orders).toContain("close the second row on Contact point with the first row's word");
  });

  test("the lines 3f made false are gone, and the hard gate reads as W.10 words it", () => {
    const all = readmeLines().join("\n");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Until sub-project 3f's off-server copy of decisions");
    expect(all).not.toContain("take the app's public hostname off the tunnel and leave the console's on");
    expect(all).not.toContain("staff.js account-facts");
    expect(all).not.toContain("account-facts <handle>");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Authorities' orders before 3f.");
    expect(all).not.toContain("in their own records until sub-project 3f");
    expect(all).not.toContain("With sub-project 3f the authorities' contact address is published as well");
    // 3d Task 2 (W.11): the gate's first line reads 3d's quarantine and release; 3d Task 8: and the lists, now that 3d's
    // owner's list stands beside 3f's.
    expect(all).toContain("until sub-project 3f's order path and sub-project 3d's quarantine and release have shipped and the lists below are done");
  });
});

/**
 * 3d Task 1 (design, W.11): the README's sections Quarantine and Backups. Quarantine stands after Authorities' orders
 * with its six steps in W.11's order, each command as the operator types it; Backups before Restoring, with the days of

  const QUARANTINE_STEPS = [
    "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js quarantine-list > list",
    "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml --profile quarantine run --rm -T quarantine < list > receipt",

    "Nobody opens a file of the quarantine",

  test("Quarantine stands after Authorities' orders, with its six steps in their order, each command as the operator types it", () => {

    const steps = sectionLines("## Quarantine").filter((line) => /^[0-9][.] /.test(line));

    for (const [n, lead] of QUARANTINE_STEPS.entries()) expect(withoutCodeMarks(steps[n]!).includes(withoutCodeMarks(lead)), lead).toBe(true);

});

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2, 7.3 and W.11): the release's runbook, "A release" under Quarantine, and the steps of
 * Restoring that replay releases. An assessment releases nothing; the leave is recorded with release-leave, withdrawn
 * at once when it was a mistake; release-show prints the record; the backups' day comes from RETENTION.backupDays. After
 * a restore, release-replay, the inventory, the lost leave and the lost withdrawal, and the site that opens only when no
 * gap is left. No line of the README says the software cannot release, and the R2 bullet no longer destroys by hand.
 */
describe("the README's release (3d design, W.11)", () => {
  test("A release stands under Quarantine: an assessment releases nothing, the leave is a fact of its own, a mistaken one is withdrawn, release-show prints the record", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    const at = lines.indexOf("### A release");
    expect(at).toBeGreaterThan(lines.indexOf("## Quarantine"));
    const text = sectionLines("## Quarantine").slice(sectionLines("## Quarantine").indexOf("### A release")).join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain("An authority's assessment is not leave to destroy.");

    const outside = REFERENCES.reduce((rest, pattern) => rest.replace(pattern, (_match: string, lead: unknown) => (typeof lead === "string" ? `${lead} ` : " ")), text).replace(/R[12]/g, " ");
    expect((outside.match(/[0-9]+/g) ?? []).filter((digits) => !values.has(digits))).toEqual([]);

    const text = sectionLines("## Restoring").join(" ");

      "a measure a program had taken is taken again by a person",

/**
 * The README after the one adversarial review of 3d as built (Task 9): the counts' Valkey and what its loss costs (H3);
 * opening the app's site recreates the API and the worker with Caddy, since only they read APP_SITE's refusal of a test
 * adapter (M8); Restoring keeps the pre-restore media-store and runs the Quarantine steps 1 to 3 before the inventory and
 * after it (M9); the command forms of automation-status, an empty inventory's receipt and release-show after a replay
 * (M16); and head-restore-mark before the API starts again (L2).
 */
describe("the README after the review of 3d (Task 9)", () => {
  /** The README's sentences, split where a sentence ends and the next begins with a capital, a code mark or a bracket. */
  const sentences = () => readmeLines().flatMap((line) => line.split(/(?<=[.;]) +(?=[A-Z`(])/));

  test("review H3: the recipients' count lives in the counts service, which writes nothing to disk; a lost counts store loses the running month, which reads not recorded", () => {
    const text = readmeLines().join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain(
      "The recipients' count (the day's key and the counting sketches of the transparency page) lives in a Valkey of its own, the service `counts`, which writes nothing to disk: no append-only file, no snapshot, no volume.",
    );
    expect(text).toContain("A restart of `counts` loses the running month's count, which then reads " + '"not recorded"' + "; nothing else is kept there.");
    expect(sectionLines("## Restoring").join(" ")).toContain("`counts` holds nothing to restore");
    expect(text).toContain("up -d postgres redis counts mailpit");
  });

  test("review M8: every sentence that opens the app's site recreates Caddy, the API and the worker; closing it may recreate Caddy alone", () => {
    const open = sentences().filter((sentence) => sentence.includes("APP_SITE=open"));
    expect(open.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    for (const sentence of open) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d --no-deps caddy api worker");
    const closed = sentences().filter((sentence) => sentence.includes("APP_SITE=closed"));
    expect(closed.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    for (const sentence of closed) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d --no-deps caddy");
  });

  test("review M9: Restoring keeps the pre-restore media-store until the Quarantine steps have run, and runs steps 1 to 3 before the inventory and again after it", () => {
    const text = sectionLines("## Restoring").join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain("Keep the `media-store` volume as it was before the restore");
    const first = text.indexOf("the Quarantine steps 1 to 3 (list, move, record)");
    const inventory = text.indexOf("then step 6 (the inventory)", first);
    const again = text.indexOf("then steps 1 to 3 again", inventory);
    expect([first > 0, inventory > first, again > inventory]).toEqual([true, true, true]);
    expect(text).not.toContain("beginning with step 6 (the inventory)");
  });

  test("review M16: automation-status runs in the api service, an empty inventory's receipt is not recorded, and release-show takes a replay's own id", () => {
    const all = readmeLines().join(" ");
    expect(all).toContain("docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js automation-status");
    expect(sectionLines("## Automated tools").join(" ")).not.toMatch(/read `staff[.]js automation-status`/);
    const restoring = sectionLines("## Restoring").join(" ");
    expect(restoring).toContain("When the inventory's receipt is empty, skip its step 3");
    expect(restoring).toContain("`release-show` takes the replay's own id, which `release-replay` prints");
    expect(restoring).toContain("prints a note and exits 1 only for what is still owed");
  });

  test("review L2: head-restore-mark runs before the API starts again, in the keeper's-copy steps", () => {
    const lines = sectionLines("## Restoring");
    const mark = lines.findIndex((line) => line.includes("dist/staff.js head-restore-mark <day>:<value> ..."));
    const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("5. Start the API with `docker compose -f infra/compose.yml up -d api`"));
    expect(mark).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(start).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(mark).toBeLessThan(start);
  });
});

const SEAL_DECISION = "f2031425-3647-495a-8bc6-e1f203142536";
const POST = "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
const LEAVE = "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa";

/** A release block as the API answers it for a seal reported, assessed illegal, moved, with a leave from a court. */
function block(overrides: Partial<SealRelease> = {}): SealRelease {
  return {
    reported: true,
    theirReference: "ST 12/34",
    answer: "illegal",
    answeredAt: "2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z",
    handedOverAt: null,
    quarantined: true,
    preserved: false,
    leave: { id: LEAVE, from: "court", reference: "4 O 1/26", receivedOn: "2026-10-15", untold: false, untoldUntil: null },
    tellHeld: false,
    postIds: [POST],
    remaining: 0,
    silenceDays: null,
    releasedAt: null,
    basis: null,
    backupsClearAt: null,
    noticeHeld: null,
    releasedPosts: 0,
    releasedImages: 0,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** The frozen case with a seal for good in force whose decision carries this release block. */
function sealedCase(release: SealRelease, custody: CaseDecision["custody"] = { files: 4, moved: 4, movedAt: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z", toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }): CaseView {
  const view = frozenCase();
  return {
    ...view,
    decisions: [
      ...view.decisions,
      decision({
        id: SEAL_DECISION,
        kind: "final",
        ruleId: "R2",
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
        suspect: true,
        needsAdmin: true,
        actions: [{ id: SEAL_ACTION, kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] }, ...NO_STANDING }],
        custody,
        release,
      }),
    ],
  };
}
const as = (role: "admin" | "moderator"): ReleaseProps => ({ role, busy: false, error: null, onRelease: noop });
const markup = (view: CaseView, release: ReleaseProps = as("admin")) => html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} release={release} />);
const page = (view: CaseView, release: ReleaseProps = as("admin")) => text(markup(view, release));
const W = RELEASE_WORDS;

describe("the release block (3d design, section 8.5)", () => {
  test("a recorded leave: the facts, the words, the ground and the one control, for an admin", () => {
    const shown = page(sealedCase(block()));
    for (const label of [W.facts.reported.label, W.facts.answer.label, W.facts.leave.label, W.facts.tell.label, W.facts.quarantined.label, W.facts.preserved.label]) expect(shown).toContain(label);
    expect(shown).toContain("4 O 1/26");
    expect(shown).toContain("ST 12/34");
    expect(shown).toContain(W.what);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.tells);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.backups(RETENTION.backupDays));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.periodUnset);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.leave("from a court"));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.sign(1));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.button);
    expect(shown).not.toContain(W.assessed);
    expect(markup(sealedCase(block()))).toMatch(/<button type="button"[^>]*>Release and destroy<[/]button>/);
    expect(markup(sealedCase(block()))).not.toMatch(/<button type="button" disabled=""[^>]*>Release and destroy/);
    // The references are an outsider's text: drawn in a frame that says whose words they are.
    expect(shown).toContain("As recorded from the authority");
  });

  test("no leave: the answer illegal is [release.assessed] and every other answer, or none, [release.nothing]; neither offers a control", () => {
    const assessed = page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null })));
    expect(assessed).toContain(W.assessed);
    expect(assessed).not.toContain(W.button);
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null, answer: "not_illegal" })))).toContain(W.notIllegal);
    for (const answer of ["no_assessment", "other", null] as const) {
      const shown = page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null, answer, answeredAt: answer === null ? null : "2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z" })));
      expect(shown, String(answer)).toContain(W.nothing);
      expect(shown, String(answer)).not.toContain(W.button);
    }
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null, answer: null, answeredAt: null })))).toContain(`${W.facts.answer.label}${W.facts.answer.none}`);
  });

  test("a leave beside the answer not_illegal: [release.conflict] above the control", () => {
    const shown = page(sealedCase(block({ answer: "not_illegal" })));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.conflict);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.button);
    expect(shown.indexOf(W.conflict)).toBeLessThan(shown.indexOf(W.button));
  });

  test("more posts than one release names: [release.more] with the constant and the count", () => {
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ remaining: 3 })))).toContain(W.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, 3));
    expect(W.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, 3)).toContain(`the first ${RELEASE_POSTS_MAX} of them`);
  });

  test("review M1: the block is an admin's alone; a moderator, whose answer holds neither the authority's reference and assessment nor the leave, is shown none of it", () => {
    // The API leaves the four members out of a moderator's answer; the console prints no block for a moderator at all.
    const { theirReference: _reference, answer: _answer, answeredAt: _answered, leave: _leave, ...forModerator } = block();
    for (const facts of [forModerator, block()]) {
      const out = markup(sealedCase(facts), as("moderator"));
      expect(out).not.toContain(`release-${SEAL_DECISION}`);
      expect(out).not.toMatch(/class="block release/);
      expect(text(out)).not.toContain(W.adminOnly);
      expect(out).not.toMatch(/Release and destroy/);
      expect(text(out)).not.toContain("4 O 1/26");
      expect(text(out)).not.toContain("ST 12/34");
    }
    expect(markup(sealedCase(block()))).toMatch(/class="block release"/);
  });

  test('"The author may be told" in each of its three values', () => {
    expect(page(sealedCase(block()))).toContain(`${W.facts.tell.label}${W.facts.tell.atOnce}`);
    const open = page(sealedCase(block({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...block().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: null } })));
    expect(open).toContain(W.facts.tell.untold(null));
    const until = "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z";
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...block().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: until } })))).toContain(W.facts.tell.untold(bothTimes(until)));
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ tellHeld: true })))).toContain(W.facts.tell.record);
  });

  test("once released: [release.done] with the files left, the notice's state and the backups' day", () => {
    const released = block({ postIds: [], releasedAt: "2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z", basis: "leave", backupsClearAt: "2026-11-17T10:00:00.000Z", noticeHeld: true, releasedPosts: 1, releasedImages: 2 });
    const shown = page(sealedCase(released, { files: 0, moved: 0, movedAt: null, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 4, lost: 0 }));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.done(bothTimes("2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z"), 1, 2, 4, true, bothTimes("2026-11-17T10:00:00.000Z")));
    expect(shown).toContain("held until the person may be told");
    expect(shown).not.toContain(W.button);
  });

  test("the params the key signs are the block's posts, the ground leave and the recorded leave with its reference; the action names the seal", () => {
    expect(releaseParams(block())).toEqual({ postIds: [POST], basis: "leave", leaveId: LEAVE, theirReference: "4 O 1/26" });
    expect(releaseParams(block({ leave: null }))).toBeNull();
    expect(releaseParams(block({ postIds: [] }))).toBeNull();
    expect(releaseAction(SEAL_ACTION, releaseParams(block())!)).toEqual({ action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: SEAL_ACTION }, params: releaseParams(block()) });
  });

  test("no word of the block calls a release a destruction done, and every code a release route answers has the console's words", () => {
    for (const words of [W.what, W.tells, W.leave("from a court"), W.done("x", 1, 1, 1, false, "y")]) expect(words).not.toMatch(/no longer holds|destroyed it/);
    for (const code of ["release_not_open", "release_not_reported", "release_not_quarantined", "release_preserved", "release_no_leave", "release_period_unset", "release_period_running", "release_mismatch"] as const) {
      expect(CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES as readonly string[]).toContain(code);
      expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES[code].length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    }
    expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.release_period_unset).toBe(W.periodUnset);
  });
});

describe("Appeals, Home and After a restore (3d design, sections 8.2 and 8.7)", () => {
  const row: AppealRow = {
    id: "b1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    caseId: frozenCase().id,
    decisionId: SEAL_DECISION,
    filedAt: "2026-10-10T00:00:00.000Z",

    standingFirst: false,

  };

  test("[appeals.released] on a waiting appeal of a released seal", () => {
    const shown = text(html(<AppealsView rows={{ state: "ready", value: [row, { ...row, id: "b1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", released: null }] }} more={false} loadingMore={false} onLoadMore={noop} onOpenCase={noop} />));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.appealReleased(dateTime(row.released!.at), "leave"));
    expect(shown.split(W.appealReleased(dateTime(row.released!.at), "leave")).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("[home.released] one line a release of the last 30 days, and [home.undestroyed] while released files are in the quarantine", () => {
    const at = "2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z";
    const shown = text(
      html(
        <CustodyLines
          overview={overview({ quarantine: { dueIn: 0, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 4, oldest: null }, destructive: [{ kind: "seal_released", at, caseId: frozenCase().id, refusalId: null }] })}
          onOpenCase={noop}
        />,
      ),
    );
    expect(shown).toContain(W.homeUndestroyed(4));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.homeReleased(bothTimes(at)));
  });

  test("After a restore: a lost release, a lost leave and a lost withdrawal, each with its line and its sentence, and none with a control", () => {
    const gap = (action: string, id: string): RestoreGap => ({
      id,
      class: "release",
      actedAt: "2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z",
      action,
      caseId: action === "seal_released" ? frozenCase().id : null,
      orderId: null,
      itemId: null,
      kinds: [],
      closedAt: null,
      disposition: null,
      closedByDecisionId: null,
    });
    const view: RestoreView = {
      importedAt: "2026-10-18T11:00:00.000Z",
      mayOpen: false,
      retentionMay: true,
      gaps: [gap("seal_released", "c1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"), gap("release_leave_recorded", "c1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"), gap("release_leave_withdrawn", "c1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000003")],
      holds: [],
    };
    const out = html(<RestoreScreen view={view} role="admin" busy={null} notice={null} error={null} onOpenCase={noop} onOpenOrder={noop} onNotNeeded={noop} />);
    const shown = text(out);
    const C = RECOVERY_WORDS.classes.release;
    expect(shown).toContain(C.heading);
    for (const action of ["seal_released", "release_leave_recorded", "release_leave_withdrawn"]) {
      expect(shown).toContain(C.line(action, bothTimes("2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z")));
      expect(shown).toContain(C.control(action));

    expect(out).not.toContain(RECOVERY_WORDS.notNeeded);
    expect(out).not.toContain(RECOVERY_WORDS.openCase);
    expect(shown).toContain(RECOVERY_WORDS.site);
  });

  test("[restore.sealAgain] beside a lost seal for good whose post is released", () => {
    const view: RestoreView = {
      importedAt: "2026-10-18T11:00:00.000Z",
      mayOpen: false,
      retentionMay: false,

});

import { mkdtempSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import pino from "pino";
import { HealthResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { createDb } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAccount } from "../src/account";
import { createApp } from "../src/app";
import { AuthError, createAuth } from "../src/auth";
import { MemoryKv } from "../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig } from "../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../src/mail/memory";
import { createMedia } from "../src/media";
import { MemoryStore } from "../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createSocial } from "../src/social";

const key = Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64");

const config = loadConfig({
  DATABASE_URL_API: "postgres://a:b@localhost:55432/k",
  DATABASE_URL_AUTH: "postgres://a:b@localhost:55432/k",
  REDIS_URL: "redis://localhost:56379",
  COUNTS_URL: "redis://localhost:56380",
  KORBAT_VERSION: "9.9.9",
  APP_ORIGIN: "http://localhost:8081",
  AUTH_HMAC_KEY: key,
  IP_HASH_KEY: key,
  TOTP_ENC_KEY: `v1:${key}`,
  NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: `v1:${key}`,
  TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: "1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA",
  SMTP_URL: "smtp://localhost:1025",
  MAIL_FROM: "korbat <no-reply@korbat.local>",
  TERMS_VERSION: "draft-2026-09",
});

const mediaRoot = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-app-test-"));

/** The real app with every module; the database pools are created but never connect in these tests. */
function app(checks: Record<string, () => Promise<void>>, advisoryChecks?: Record<string, () => Promise<void>>) {
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
  const auth = createAuth({
    config,
    logger,
    authDb: createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 1 }),
    kv: new MemoryKv(),
    mailer: new MemoryMailer(),
    profiles: { create: async () => ({ ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" }), find: async () => null, setVerified: async () => true, suspended: async () => false },
  });
  const apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 });
  const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth() });
  const media = createMedia({
    apiDb,
    uploadsDir: path.join(mediaRoot, "uploads"),
    storeDir: path.join(mediaRoot, "store"),
    formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,
    minFreeBytes: 0,
    logger,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
    rateLimitStore,
    enforceUploadLimit: async () => undefined,
  });
  const account = createAccount({
    auth: auth.forAccount,
    social: social.forAccount,
    media: media.forAccount,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
    requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
    rateLimitStore,
    logger,
  });
  return createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: checks, advisoryChecks, auth, social, media, account });
}

describe("GET /api/health", () => {
  test("200 ok when all checks pass", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: async () => {}, redis: async () => {} }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = HealthResponse.parse(await res.json());
    expect(body).toEqual({ status: "ok", version: "9.9.9", checks: { postgres: "ok", redis: "ok" } });
  });
  test("503 degraded when a check throws", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: async () => { throw new Error("down"); }, redis: async () => {} }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(503);
    expect(HealthResponse.parse(await res.json()).checks).toEqual({ postgres: "fail", redis: "ok" });
  });
});

describe("advisory health checks", () => {
  const down = async () => {
    throw new Error("stale heartbeat");
  };
  test("a failing advisory check is reported as degraded, with status 200", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: async () => {} }, { image_worker: down }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(HealthResponse.parse(await res.json())).toEqual({ status: "degraded", version: "9.9.9", checks: { postgres: "ok", image_worker: "fail" } });
  });
  test("a failing critical check is still 503, whatever the advisory ones say", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: down }, { image_worker: async () => {} }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(503);
    expect(HealthResponse.parse(await res.json()).checks).toEqual({ postgres: "fail", image_worker: "ok" });
  });
});

describe("caching", () => {
  test("responses are no-store unless the handler set its own Cache-Control", async () => {
    const a = app({});
    a.get("/api/cached", (c) => {
      c.header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=300");
      return c.text("image bytes");

    expect((await a.request("/api/nope")).headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");

  });
});

});

    expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { code: "unauthenticated" } });
    expect((await a.request("/api/account/export")).status).toBe(404);
  });
});
