```ts
  describe("the checks of intakes", () => {
    /** One test's intakes, all in a transaction that is rolled back: each insert in a savepoint, its refusal's message or null. */
    const intakes = (fn: (refusal: (input: IntakeInput) => Promise<string | null>, ada: { id: string }) => Promise<void>) =>
      rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const ada = await profile(tx);
        await fn(async (input) => (await within(tx, (sp) => insertIntake(sp, input)))?.message ?? null, ada);
      });

    test("a ground is needed: a rule, an allegation of illegality or the CSAM path", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id })).toMatch(/intakes_has_ground/);
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R7" })).toMatch(/intakes_rule_id/);
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R1" })).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("a notice of illegality carries its explanation and its good-faith statement; the CSAM path needs neither", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        const illegal = { reporterId: ada.id, allegesIllegal: true, category: SPEECH };
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal })).toMatch(/intakes_illegal_elements/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal, explanation: "why" })).toMatch(/intakes_illegal_elements/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal, bonaFide: true })).toMatch(/intakes_illegal_elements/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal, explanation: "why", bonaFide: true })).toBeNull();
        // A CSAM intake alleges illegality with neither, and with no keyword (the "abuse" choice) or one of the three.
        const csam = { channel: "signed_out" as const, csam: true, allegesIllegal: true, category: MINORS };
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, lookupHash: hex64() })).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, lookupHash: hex64(), categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS" })).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, lookupHash: hex64(), categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toMatch(/intakes_category_keyword/);
      });
    });

    test("the CSAM path stores no account and no contact, and is always about the protection of minors", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        const csam = { csam: true, allegesIllegal: true, category: MINORS };
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, channel: "signed_in", reporterId: ada.id, lookupHash: hex64() })).toMatch(/intakes_csam/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, channel: "signed_out", contactId: randomUUID(), lookupHash: hex64() })).toMatch(/intakes_csam/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, channel: "signed_out", category: SPEECH, lookupHash: hex64() })).toMatch(/intakes_csam/);
        // Signed in, it still stores no account: the channel is kept, the reporter is not, and the token's hash is needed.
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, channel: "signed_in", lookupHash: hex64() })).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ ...csam, channel: "signed_in" })).toMatch(/intakes_lookup/);
      });
    });

    test("a user never reports under R2, signed in or out; a moderator's finding may cite it", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R2" })).toMatch(/intakes_r2_finding_only/);
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_out", lookupHash: hex64(), ruleId: "R2" })).toMatch(/intakes_r2_finding_only/);
        expect(await refusal({ kind: "finding", channel: "staff", findingBy: ada.id, ruleId: "R2", category: MINORS })).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("a finding names its finder, comes through the staff channel and never alleges illegality", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        const finding = { kind: "finding" as const, channel: "staff" as const, findingBy: ada.id, ruleId: "R3" };
        expect(await refusal(finding)).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ ...finding, allegesIllegal: true, category: SPEECH, explanation: "why", bonaFide: true })).toMatch(/intakes_finding_legal/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...finding, findingBy: null })).toMatch(/intakes_finding/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...finding, channel: "signed_in" })).toMatch(/intakes_finding/);
        expect(await refusal({ kind: "user", channel: "staff", ruleId: "R3" })).toMatch(/intakes_finding/);
        expect(await refusal({ kind: "user", channel: "signed_in", findingBy: ada.id, ruleId: "R3" })).toMatch(/intakes_finding/);
      });
    });

    test("a contact belongs to a signed-out notice, a reporter to a signed-in one, and a token's hash to a signed-out or CSAM one", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_in", reporterId: ada.id, contactId: randomUUID(), ruleId: "R1" })).toMatch(/intakes_contact_signed_out/);
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_out", reporterId: ada.id, lookupHash: hex64(), ruleId: "R1" })).toMatch(/intakes_reporter_signed_in/);
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_out", ruleId: "R1" })).toMatch(/intakes_lookup/);
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_in", reporterId: ada.id, lookupHash: hex64(), ruleId: "R1" })).toMatch(/intakes_lookup/);
        const hash = hex64();
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_out", lookupHash: hash, ruleId: "R1" })).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ channel: "signed_out", lookupHash: hash, ruleId: "R1" })).toMatch(/intakes_lookup_hash_unique/);
      });
    });

    test("the category is one of the 16, never the terms-and-conditions one on an allegation of illegality; the texts are bounded; the reference has its form", async () => {
      await intakes(async (refusal, ada) => {
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PORNOGRAPHY_OR_SEXUALIZED_CONTENT" })).toMatch(/intakes_category/);
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, allegesIllegal: true, category: TC, explanation: "why", bonaFide: true })).toMatch(/intakes_illegal_not_tc/);
        const illegal = { reporterId: ada.id, allegesIllegal: true, category: SPEECH, bonaFide: true };
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal, explanation: "x".repeat(2000), citedLaw: "y".repeat(300) })).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal, explanation: "x".repeat(2001) })).toMatch(/intakes_explanation_len/);
        expect(await refusal({ ...illegal, explanation: "why", citedLaw: "y".repeat(301) })).toMatch(/intakes_cited_law_len/);
        for (const ref of ["N-ABCDEFGH2", "n-ABCDEFGHJ2", "N-abcdefghj2", "N-ABCDEFGH01", "N-ABCDEFGHJ23", "X-ABCDEFGHJ2"]) expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R1", ref }), ref).toMatch(/intakes_ref/);
        const ref = newRef();
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R1", ref })).toBeNull();
        expect(await refusal({ reporterId: ada.id, ruleId: "R1", ref })).toMatch(/intakes_ref_unique/);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("the staff_texts CHECK", () => {
    type Save = (text: string | null, salt: string | null, digest: string, erased?: boolean) => Promise<{ message: string; code: string } | null>;
    /** One test's texts on a case of their own, in a transaction that is rolled back; each insert in a savepoint. */
    const texts = (fn: (save: Save, tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
      rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const ada = await profile(tx);
        const caseId = await openCase(tx, "post", await newPostRow(tx, ada.id));
        const save: Save = (text, salt, digest, erased = false) =>
          run(tx, sql`insert into staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest, erased_at) values (${caseId}::uuid, ${ada.id}::uuid, 'facts', ${text}, ${salt}, ${digest}, ${erased ? sql`now()` : sql`null`})`);
        await fn(save, tx);
      });

    test.each(TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => [vector.name, vector] as const))("%s: SQL computes the digest the contracts' textDigest computes", async (_name, vector) => {
      expect(await sqlDigest(apiDb, vector.salt, vector.text)).toBe(vector.digest);
    });

    test("a text is stored with the digest the contracts compute for its salt and itself, and with no other", async () => {
      await texts(async (save) => {
        // Fresh salts: a digest names one text, so a vector's own digest could be stored only once.
        for (const vector of TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS) {
          const salt = hex64();
          const digest = await textDigest(salt, vector.text);
          expect(await save(vector.text, salt, digest), vector.name).toBeNull();
          // The same text under the digest of another salt, or of another text, is refused.
          expect((await save(vector.text, hex64(), digest))?.message, vector.name).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest/);
          expect((await save(`${vector.text}.`, salt, digest))?.message, vector.name).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest/);
        }
      });
    });

    test("a digest names one text; a text has a salt; only an erased row has neither", async () => {
      await texts(async (save) => {
        const salt = hex64();
        const digest = await textDigest(salt, "a text");
        expect(await save("a text", salt, digest)).toBeNull();
        expect((await save("a text", salt, digest))?.message).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest_unique/);
        expect((await save("a text", null, hex64()))?.message).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest/);
        expect((await save(null, hex64(), hex64()))?.message).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest/);
        expect((await save(null, null, hex64()))?.message).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest/);
        expect((await save("a text", hex64(), hex64(), true))?.message).toMatch(/staff_texts_digest/);
        // The erased form: text and salt gone, the digest kept.
        expect(await save(null, null, hex64(), true)).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("the salt is 32 bytes as lower-case hex: an empty, a short or an upper-case salt is refused, also with the digest it gives", async () => {
      await texts(async (save, tx) => {
        const salt = hex64();
        // hex decodes either case to the same bytes, so the upper-case spelling has the lower-case salt's digest.
        const upper = salt.toUpperCase();
        expect(await sqlDigest(tx, upper, "a text")).toBe(await textDigest(salt, "a text"));
        for (const malformed of ["", salt.slice(2), upper, `${salt}00`]) {
          const err = await save("a text", malformed, await sqlDigest(tx, malformed, "a text"));
          expect(err, JSON.stringify(malformed)).toMatchObject({ code: "23514", message: expect.stringMatching(/staff_texts_digest/) });
        }
        expect(await save("a text", salt, await textDigest(salt, "a text"))).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("a text longer than 5000 characters is refused whatever its digest", async () => {
      await texts(async (save, tx) => {
        const salt = hex64();
        const long = "x".repeat(5001);
        expect((await save(long, salt, await sqlDigest(tx, salt, long)))?.message).toMatch(/staff_texts_text_len/);
      });
    });
  });

  test("a decision's keyword needs the ground of the law: on a decision without a ground, or on a rule, it is refused", async () => {
    // The decision is a real one, on a reported post; the migrator then changes its row, the only role that can, in a
    // transaction that is rolled back.
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      const { postId } = await imagePost(tx);
      const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(postId));
      const decisionId = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
      const keyword = DECISION_KEYWORDS[0];
      const set = (changes: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => run(tx, sql`update decisions set ${changes} where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
      const refused = { code: "23514", message: expect.stringMatching(/decisions_keyword/) };
      // A null ground is the row a plain comparison let through: its result is null, and a check passes on a null.
      expect(await set(sql`category_keyword = ${keyword}`)).toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(await set(sql`category_keyword = ${keyword}, ground = 'incompatible', rule_id = 'R1'`)).toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(await set(sql`category_keyword = ${keyword}, ground = 'illegal', legal_reference_digest = ${hex64()}`)).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("the limits' row is the migration's: 60 decisions an hour and 300 a day, 400 case opens, 50 findings and 10 reveals a day", async () => {
    // The suite's setup leaves this table alone, so the row read here is the one migration 0015 inserted.
    const rows = await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select id, decisions_per_hour, decisions_per_day, case_opens_per_day, findings_per_day, reveals_per_day from moderation_limits`);
    expect(rows.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ id: 1, decisions_per_hour: 60, decisions_per_day: 300, case_opens_per_day: 400, findings_per_day: 50, reveals_per_day: 10 }]);
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const err = await run(tx, sql`insert into moderation_limits (id, decisions_per_hour, decisions_per_day, case_opens_per_day, findings_per_day, reveals_per_day, updated_at) values (2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, now())`);
      expect(err?.message).toMatch(/moderation_limits_single_row/);
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: a refused upload after its refusal (3d Task 7)", () => {

  /** An uploader whose upload of the acting file was refused: the refusal's id and the image's. */
  async function refused() {

    const opened = await cli(["upload-report", r.refusalId, "--duty", "voluntary"]);
    expect(opened.code).toBe(0);

    expect(opened.text).toContain("the uploader's account no longer exists");
    expect((await cli(["upload-report", r.refusalId, "--duty", "voluntary"])).text).toContain("has its record of a report already");
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select notification_id as id from upload_refusals where id = ${r.refusalId}::uuid`);
    const page = await world.moderation.forStaff.uploads(admin.session);
    const listed = page.uploads.find((found) => found.id === r.refusalId)!;
    // `reported` says that the record of a report is opened (8.1); the release block says whether it was sent.
    expect(listed).toMatchObject({ endAs: "report", uploaderGone: true, reported: true, quarantined: false, release: { reported: false } });
    // No hash value (the hash type alone), no handle.
    expect(JSON.stringify(listed)).not.toMatch(/[0-9a-f]{32}|"hash"|handle/);
    // A leave cannot be recorded before the report is sent; then it can, on the refusal.
    const leave = ["release-leave", r.refusalId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "4 O 1/26", "--day", "2026-10-18", "--operator", "the operator"];
    expect((await cli(leave)).text).toContain("has no record of a report that was sent");
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'sent', sent_at = now(), authority = 'A test authority', channel = 'portal', sent_kinds = array['files'], not_kept_version = 1, closed_at = now() where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
    const recorded = await cli(leave);

    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ reported: true, quarantined: false, releasedAt: null, leave: { reference: "4 O 1/26" } });

    const seen = (await world.moderation.forStaff.uploads(moderator.session)).uploads.find((found) => found.id === r.refusalId)!;
    expect(Object.keys(seen)).not.toContain("otherRefusals");
    expect(Object.keys(seen.release!).filter((key) => ["theirReference", "answer", "answeredAt", "leave"].includes(key))).toEqual([]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(seen)).not.toContain("4 O 1/26");
    const params = { basis: "leave" as const, leaveId: facts.leave!.id, theirReference: "4 O 1/26" };
    const release = async (member: RealStaff) =>
      world.moderation.forStaff.releaseUpload(member.session, await world.confirmAction(member, { action: "upload_released", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: r.refusalId }, params }), { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    // Not before both files are in the quarantine by record; never by a moderator.
    expect(await refusal(release(admin))).toBe("release_not_quarantined");
    for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${r.mediaId}::uuid, ${storedImageName(r.mediaId, size)}, 1234, ${"b".repeat(64)}) on conflict do nothing`);

    expect((await holdOf(r.mediaId))!.erased).toBe(true);

        values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, 900000000 + ${gaps.length}, ${"c".repeat(64)}, 'upload_hold_ended', 'upload_refusal', ${refusalId},
                ${JSON.stringify({ mediaId, params: { endAs, reason: endAs === "no_report" ? "other" : null } })}::jsonb, now() - interval '1 hour', now(), 'release')
        returning id`);

      return made!.id;

    expect(after!.disposition).toBe("imported");
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ result: string }>(sql`select public.upload_hold_replay(${r.refusalId}::uuid, ${r.mediaId}::uuid, 'report', now()) as result`))[0]!.result).toBe("present");

  });

});
```

```ts
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  decisionId: string;

}

 * the plan lists for a seal for good and for a seal taken while deciding, before and after a move and after an
 * unseal_media; what the insert and update triggers force; the CHECKs; the six functions the API's role may call and the
 * table and the plan it may not reach; the count against seal_posts.images; quarantine_due daily from 24 hours; what the
 * owner's status and serve say of an image being restored or lost; and the lost image's notice, once. The seals commit
 * with real keys; every other change is made as the migrator in a transaction that is rolled back, and the last test
 * removes what the file committed.

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the quarantine's plan and record (3d Task 1)", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;

  let forGood: Sealed;

  async function sealed(images: number, how: "final" | "deciding"): Promise<Sealed> {

    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {

      // Every move this file made due is younger than the threshold: no alert.
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);

      const almost = `${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours - 1} hours`;

      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);

      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { decision: forGood.decisionId }, "2 hours");
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);

      expect(await dueRows()).toEqual([{ step: 0, facts: { count: c.due_in + c.due_out, oldestAt: oldest!.at } }]);
      // Daily: not again the same day, again the next.
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect(await dueRows()).toHaveLength(1);
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { alerts: "quarantine_due" }, `${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours + 1} hours`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await dueRows()).map((row) => row.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // Once every due move is recorded, the alert stops.
      for (const id of forGood.mediaIds) for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) await moved(tx, id, size);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set returned_at = now() where media_id = ${lifted.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid and lost_at is null`);

      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await dueRows()).length).toBe(after.due_in + after.due_out === 0 ? 2 : 3);
    });
  });
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_SIZES } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { restoreImport } from "../../src/cli/restore";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { restoreView } from "../../src/moderation/gaps";
import { releaseNotices } from "../../src/moderation/release";
import { exportLines } from "../../src/staff";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, imagePost, postFrozen, report, restoreForTest, rowCounts, snapshotForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, sealActionOf } from "./records-fixtures";
import { moveForTest, reportForTest } from "./release-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A sealed post of this file. */
interface Sealed {
  authorId: string;
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  sealActionId: string;
}

/**
 * A restore cannot bring a released image back into keeping, and loses none of the release's acts in silence (3d design,
 * sections 6.2, 7.3 and 8.7; 12.1 row 17; LAB D2 to D4 on the built code). Before the backup: two seals for good,
 * reported and moved; a leave for the first, and a leave for the second that is later withdrawn. Then, lost with the
 * restore: the release of the first; a new leave for the second and its release; the withdrawal; and a leave recorded
 * and withdrawn within the lost work. After restoreForTest and restore-import: one gap of the class release for each
 * release, for the lost leave and for the lost withdrawal, none for the leave recorded and withdrawn after the backup;
 * the app's site stays closed. release-replay marks the posts and erases their rows, a seal still standing freezes
 * nothing (D4), and a second run finds them present; the replay of the release whose leave is lost is born held and is
 * told in the dispatch round after release-leave --gap records the leave again under its id; release-leave --withdraw
 * --gap closes the last gap; the list prints the released files to destroy. The file restores the database it found.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: a restore and the replay of releases (3d Task 2)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let found: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let appOrigin: string;
  let head: { seq: number; hash: string };
  let backup: string;
  let tail: string[] = [];
  let first: Sealed;
  let second: Sealed;
  let firstRelease: string;
  let secondRelease: string;
  let lostLeave: string;
  let withdrawnLeave: string;
  const mails: string[] = [];
  const auth = new Proxy({} as AuthForModeration, {
    get: (_target, member) => {
      if (typeof member !== "string" || member === "then") return undefined;
      if (member === "mailAccount") return async (_userId: string, message: { template: string }) => (mails.push(message.template), "sent");
      if (member === "mailStaff") return async () => 1;
      if (member === "overdueContacts") return async () => 0;
      return async () => undefined;
    },
  });

  const readHead = async () => {
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ seq: string; hash: string }>(sql`select seq::text as seq, hash from public.audit_head where id = 1`);
    return { seq: Number(row!.seq), hash: row!.hash };
  };
  const cli = async (args: string[], input = "") => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! }, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input, "utf8"));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(LF) };

  const leaveOf = (text: string) => /leave ([0-9a-f-]{36}) recorded/.exec(text)![1]!;
  async function sealed(): Promise<Sealed> {

    const outcome = await world.moderation.forStaff.release(admin.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    await world.moderation.settle();

    return outcome.releaseId;

    );

  const openGaps = async () =>

    )).map((row) => ({ ...row }));

  beforeAll(async () => {

    withdrawnLeave = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "authority", "--reference", "WRONG 2", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, metadata) select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, 'filler', jsonb_build_object('n', n) from generate_series(1, 5) n`);
    head = await readHead();
    backup = await snapshotForTest(migrateDb);
    // The lost work.
    firstRelease = await release(first, firstLeave, "1 A 1/26");
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", "--withdraw", withdrawnLeave, "--operator", "op"])).code).toBe(0);
    lostLeave = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "2 B 2/26", "--day", "2026-10-03", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    secondRelease = await release(second, lostLeave, "2 B 2/26");
    const passing = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "PASSING", "--day", "2026-10-03", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", "--withdraw", passing, "--operator", "op"])).code).toBe(0);
    const through = (await readHead()).seq;
    for await (const line of exportLines(apiDb, head.seq - 3, through)) tail.push(JSON.stringify(line));
  }, 300_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, found);
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  test("restore-import: a gap of the class release for each release, the lost leave and the lost withdrawal; none for a leave recorded and withdrawn after the backup; the site stays closed", async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, backup);
    expect(await readHead()).toEqual(head);
    expect(await releases(first.postId)).toEqual([]);
    const done = await restoreImport(migrateDb, [], Buffer.from(tail.map((line) => line + LF).join(""), "utf8"), appOrigin);
    expect(done.ok).toBe(true);
    const gaps = await openGaps();
    expect(gaps.map((gap) => [gap.action, gap.release ?? gap.leave])).toEqual([
      ["seal_released", firstRelease],

  test("release-replay: the posts marked, the rows erased, the gaps closed; a seal that stands freezes nothing; a second run finds them present; a line no gap names is refused", async () => {
    const replayed = await cli(["release-replay"], tail.join(LF));
    expect(replayed.lines[0]).toBe("out release-replay: 2 releases and 0 ends of a hold in the copy; 0 already present.");

    expect(refused.text).toMatch(/replay_no_gap/);

    for (const seal of [first, second]) for (const mediaId of seal.mediaIds) for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) expect(listed.lines).toContain(`out destroy ${mediaId} ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)}`);

    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, found);
    found = await snapshotForTest(migrateDb);

  });
```

```ts
 * moderation module's own function under real staff keys: the leave recorded by staff.js release-leave, the case answer's
 * release block, the release and its confirmed audit row, the alert seal_released to every staff account, the author's
 * notice at once, or born held while the leave is not to be told and sent by the dispatch round that finds the hold

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the release, as an admin takes it (3d Task 2)", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;

  let atOnce: Sealed;

  const staffMails: string[] = [];

  /** The auth module's interface as moderation calls it, recording every mail and taking each. */
  const auth = new Proxy({} as AuthForModeration, {
    get: (_target, member) => {
      if (typeof member !== "string" || member === "then") return undefined;
      if (member === "mailAccount") return async (userId: string, message: { template: string }) => (accountMails.push({ userId, template: message.template }), "sent");
      if (member === "mailStaff") return async (message: { template: string }) => (staffMails.push(message.template), 1);
      if (member === "overdueContacts") return async () => 0;
      return async () => undefined;

  });

  const cli = async (args: string[], input = "") => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! }, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input, "utf8"));

  async function release(member: RealStaff, seal: Sealed, params?: SealReleasedParams) {
    // The params as an admin's block shows them: a moderator's block has no leave (review ruling M1).
    const block = (await blockOf(admin, seal)).release!;
```

```ts
 * automated exists.

  const figuresOf = async (tx: DbTx, year: number, asOf: Date = new Date()): Promise<Figures> => {

  const publish = async (tx: DbTx, year: number, reason: string): Promise<number | null | string> => {
    let version: number | null = null;
    const refused = await refusal(
      tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        const [row] = await sp.execute<{ v: number | null }>(sql`select public.edition_publish(${year}::int, ${reason}) as v`);

        for (const { path, text } of stringsOf(stored!.figures)) {
          const isLabel = LABELS.has(path.split(".").at(-1)!);
          expect([path, isLabel || /^(0|1 to 9|about [1-9][0-9]*0|not recorded)$/.test(text)]).toEqual([path, true]);
        }
        // Every row of a table split by a label is 10 or more, but the folded row.
        for (const table of [stored!.figures.restrictions.byGround, stored!.figures.intakes, stored!.figures.appeals, stored!.figures.accountMeasures]) {
          for (const row of table) if (row.label !== "other") expect([row.label, named(row.count) >= 10]).toEqual([row.label, true]);
        }
      }
    });
  });

  test("edition_publish: version 1 with the system's audit row; a held order absent, then a version hold_ended that changes the order section alone; only a correction counts the tables again; nothing updates a version", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {

        moderator,

      expect({ reason: first!.reason, method: first!.method, same: first!.computed_at === first!.published_at }).toEqual({ reason: "first", method: TRANSPARENCY_RULES.method, same: true });
      expect(first!.figures.orders?.received).toEqual({ total: 1, crossBorder: 0 });
      const audit = await newestAudit(tx);
      expect(audit).toEqual({
        action: "edition_published",

        target_type: "edition",
        target_id: `${YEAR}.1`,
        metadata: { year: YEAR, version: 1, reason: "first" },
        key_id: null,
        step_up: null,
      });
      // Asked again with nothing new: nothing.
      expect(await publish(tx, YEAR, "first")).toBeNull();

      // In between, more decisions of the year come to light (the spare restrictions move into it), and the held
      // order's hold ends and its notice is told.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.decisions set decided_at = make_timestamptz(${YEAR}::int, 7, 7, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC') where id = any(${`{${spareIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = clock_timestamp() where id = ${orders[1]!.id}::uuid`);
      const [told] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.order_notices_release() as n`);
      expect(told!.n).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

      expect(await publish(tx, YEAR, "first")).toBe(2);
      const [, second] = await editions(tx, YEAR);
      expect(second!.reason).toBe("hold_ended");
      const { orders: firstOrders, ...firstTables } = first!.figures;
      const { orders: secondOrders, ...secondTables } = second!.figures;
      expect(secondTables).toEqual(firstTables);
      expect(firstOrders?.received?.total).toBe(1);
      expect(secondOrders?.received).toEqual({ total: 2, crossBorder: 0 });
      expect((await newestAudit(tx)).metadata).toEqual({ year: YEAR, version: 2, reason: "hold_ended" });
      expect(await publish(tx, YEAR, "first")).toBeNull();

      // A version is never changed, by any role, the migrator included.
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.transparency_editions set figures = '{}'::jsonb where year = ${YEAR} and version = 1`)))).toBe("edition_frozen");
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.transparency_editions set reason = 'correction' where year = ${YEAR} and version = 2`)))).toBe("edition_frozen");

      // The migrator's correction counts every table again, as of the same due day: the spare restrictions now count.
      expect(await publish(tx, YEAR, "correction")).toBe(3);
      const [, , third] = await editions(tx, YEAR);
      expect(third!.reason).toBe("correction");
      expect(third!.figures.restrictions.total).toBe(band(39));
      expect(first!.figures.restrictions.total).toBe(band(24));
      expect(third!.figures.orders?.received).toEqual({ total: 2, crossBorder: 0 });
      // A reason the caller may not give.
      expect(await publish(tx, YEAR, "hold_ended")).toBe("invalid_edition");
    });
  });

    });
  });

/** tco-counts' figures as the order section holds them: without the year and the issuing state. */
function withoutState(counts: TcoCounts): Record<string, unknown> {
  const { year: _year, received, ...rest } = counts;
  return { ...rest, received: received === null ? null : { total: received.total, crossBorder: received.crossBorder } };
}
```

### Replace `apps/api/test/integration/transparency-fixtures.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { matchForTest } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { hex64, imagePost, newImageRow, newRef, openCase, type Runner, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ageOrderForTest, effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest } from "./orders-fixtures";

/**
 * yearForTest (3d design, section 12; Task 4, grown in Task 6 for decisions without a decider and in Task 7 for refused
 * uploads): a past year of decisions, intakes, appeals, account measures and orders, written cell by cell as the migrator
 * inside the caller's transaction, which the caller rolls back. LAB E wrote its synthetic decisions with the triggers off
 * (`e-counts.sql`); so does this fixture, for the rows of the tables it fills by the hundred: the migrator owns them, and
 * `alter table ... disable trigger user` holds only until the transaction ends, so nothing it writes outlives the test.
 * It does that first, while the transaction has queued no trigger event on those tables, and switches the triggers on
 * again before the orders, which go through 3f's real flows (as cli-counts.test.ts writes its fixture year) and are then
 * moved back into the year by ageOrderForTest.
 *
 * Each row of a cell gets a time in the year (in UTC) spread over its months, as the lab spread them: the row's number
 * modulo 12 picks the month and modulo 28 the day, at noon. A row counted by its later fate (an appeal's answer) has
 * that fate in the year too.
 */

/** A rule's id, or the law: what a restriction cites. */
export type GroundLabel = "R1" | "R2" | "R3" | "R4" | "R5" | "R6" | "law";

/** One order of the year, given effect through 3f's real flows and moved back into the year. */
export interface OrderCell {
  /** How many posts the order names; it disables the first `effectOn` of them (all by default). */
  posts: number;
  effectOn?: number;
  memberState?: "DE" | "FR";
  /** The instant of its last disabling, in the year or after it; noon on 15 June of the year by default. */
  disabledAt?: Date;
  /** Its receipt this many minutes before its last disabling; none recorded when absent. */
  receivedBefore?: number;
  /**
   * A notice held under Section C: its order decisions stay untold, and its hold runs to this instant (written as the
   * hold's recorded end, the one way a past removal order's hold can still run; the test ends it the same way).
   */
  heldUntil?: Date;
}

/** The cells of a year. Every number is how many rows the cell holds. */
export interface YearCells {
  /** Final decisions that restrict, by what they cite, each with one ledger row of `measure` (remove by default). */
  restrictions?: Partial<Record<GroundLabel, number>>;
  measure?: "remove" | "withhold" | "remove_media" | "reset_bio";
  /** Interim decisions that restrict, each citing R4 with one withhold. */
  interim?: number;
  /** Final decisions that found no breach (no_violation). */
  noBreach?: number;
  /** Intakes by kind: a report under a rule, a notice of illegality, a moderator's finding. */
  intakes?: Partial<Record<"rules" | "illegal" | "finding", number>>;
  /** Appeals answered in the year, by their result; each appeals a decision of the year before, so no restriction of the year is added. */
  appeals?: Partial<Record<"kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed", number>>;
  /** 3e's account measures, each on a final decision of the year that restricts under R6 (which therefore counts as a restriction too). */
  accountMeasures?: Partial<Record<"strike" | "suspend" | "terminate" | "retire_handle" | "warn_reporting" | "restrict_reporting", number>>;
  orders?: OrderCell[];
  /** Restrictions under R3 dated in the year before, which a test may move into the year later: what a correction counts again. */
  spare?: number;
  /**
   * 3d Task 6: a program's rows. `findings`: intakes of the kind automated on the channel system, by the rule each cites;
   * of the R1 ones, `restrictedR1` have an item on the year's case, so a person's final restriction of the year
   * (`restrictions`, which the test sets) restricted them. `measures`: decisions without a decider, interim, restricting and
   * fully automated, by rule, each with its one ledger row: a withhold of the year's post's image under R1, a seal of its
   * images under R2.
   */
  automated?: { findings?: Partial<Record<"R1" | "R2", number>>; restrictedR1?: number; measures?: Partial<Record<"R1" | "R2", number>> };
  /**
   * 3d Task 7: refused uploads of the year, by how their hold had ended by the edition's due day: ended as report, ended as
   * no_report, or not at all (open). Each is an image row on no post with its acting match record and its refusal, written
   * with the refusal's triggers off; an end is in the year, before the due day.
   */
  uploads?: Partial<Record<"report" | "no_report" | "open", number>>;
}

/**
 * 3d review M3: an account created on 1 January of `year`, so edition_publish counts the year as one korbat ran (it
 * stores nothing for a year that ended before the oldest account's creation). Answers its id; the caller removes it.
 */
export async function accountSince(db: Runner, year: number): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into public.profiles (id, handle, display_name, created_at) values (gen_random_uuid(), ${`y_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`}, 'Since', make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC')) returning id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/** What the fixture made that a test reads again. */
export interface YearMade {
  caseId: string;
  orders: OrderView[];
  /** The decisions of `spare`. */
  spareIds: string[];
}

/** The tables the fixture fills with its triggers off; 3d Task 6 adds the items of a program's findings. */
const BULK_TABLES = ["decisions", "decision_actions", "intakes", "intake_items", "appeals"] as const;

/** A row's time in the year: its number picks the month and the day, at noon UTC. */
const spread = (year: number) => sql`make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 1 + (g::int % 12), 1 + (g::int % 28), 12, 0, 0, 'UTC')`;

export async function yearForTest(tx: DbTx, year: number, cells: YearCells, staff: TestStaff): Promise<YearMade> {
  // One post and its case, which every bulk decision names: the ledger needs a case, a snapshot and a decider.
  // 3d Task 6: with an image when a program's measures withhold one.
  const { authorId, postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(tx, cells.automated?.measures ? 1 : 0);
  // 3d review M3: the post's author is an account created on 1 January of the year, so the year is one korbat ran and
  // edition_publish stores its edition.
  await tx.execute(sql`update public.profiles set created_at = make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC') where id = ${authorId}::uuid`);
  const caseId = await openCase(tx, "post", postId);
  const [snapshot] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    insert into public.evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, digest)
    values (${caseId}::uuid, 'post', ${postId}::uuid, 'author', ${hex64()}) returning id`);
  const spareIds: string[] = [];

  for (const table of BULK_TABLES) await tx.execute(sql.raw(`alter table public.${table} disable trigger user`));
  {
    /** Inserts `n` decisions with the columns given, each with one ledger row of `measure` when it restricts. */
    const decisions = async (n: number, d: { kind: "final" | "interim" | "review"; outcome: string; ground: "incompatible" | "illegal" | null; ruleId: string | null; at: ReturnType<typeof spread>; measure: string | null }) => {
      if (n <= 0) return [] as string[];
      const legal = d.ground === "illegal" ? hex64() : null;
      const restricted = d.outcome === "restricted";
      const rows = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
        insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                      snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, facts_digest, reason_digest, legal_reference_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid,
                                      informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
        select ${caseId}::uuid, ${d.kind}::public.decision_kind, 0, ${d.outcome}::public.decision_outcome, ${d.ground}::public.decision_ground, ${d.ruleId},
               3, 3, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', 'report', ${snapshot!.id}::uuid, ${hex64()}, ${restricted ? hex64() : null}, ${restricted ? hex64() : null}, ${legal},
               ${staff.id}::uuid, ${d.at}, '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g::text), ${d.at}, false, false, false
          from generate_series(1, ${n}::int) g
        returning id`);
      const ids = rows.map((row) => row.id);
      if (d.measure !== null) {
        await tx.execute(sql`
          insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, post_id, created_at)
          select d.id, ${d.measure}::public.action_kind, ${authorId}::uuid, ${postId}::uuid, d.decided_at from public.decisions d where d.id = any(${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      }
      return ids;
    };

    const measure = cells.measure ?? "remove";
    for (const [label, n] of Object.entries(cells.restrictions ?? {}) as [GroundLabel, number][]) {
      await decisions(n, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: label === "law" ? "illegal" : "incompatible", ruleId: label === "law" ? null : label, at: spread(year), measure });
    }
    await decisions(cells.interim ?? 0, { kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R4", at: spread(year), measure: "withhold" });
    await decisions(cells.noBreach ?? 0, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, at: spread(year), measure: null });
    spareIds.push(...(await decisions(cells.spare ?? 0, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R3", at: spread(year - 1), measure })));
    for (const [kind, n] of Object.entries(cells.accountMeasures ?? {}) as [string, number][]) {
      await decisions(n, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", at: spread(year), measure: kind });
    }

    for (const [label, n] of Object.entries(cells.intakes ?? {}) as ["rules" | "illegal" | "finding", number][]) {
      const finding = label === "finding";
      const illegal = label === "illegal";
      await tx.execute(sql`
        insert into public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, finding_by, rule_id, alleges_illegal, category, explanation, bona_fide, received_at)
        select ${finding ? "finding" : "user"}::public.intake_kind, r.ref,
               ${finding ? "staff" : "signed_in"}::public.intake_channel, ${finding ? staff.id : null}::uuid, ${illegal ? null : finding ? "R3" : "R1"},
               ${illegal}, ${illegal ? "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH" : "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC"}, ${illegal ? "it is illegal" : null}, ${illegal},
               ${spread(year)}
          from unnest(${`{${Array.from({ length: n }, () => newRef()).join(",")}}`}::text[]) with ordinality as r(ref, g)`);
    }

    // 3d Task 6: a program's findings and measures. The new label and channel are cast at run time, on a database that has
    // them; the figures function compares them as text.
    for (const [rule, n] of Object.entries(cells.automated?.findings ?? {}) as ["R1" | "R2", number][]) {
      const restricted = rule === "R1" ? Math.min(n, cells.automated?.restrictedR1 ?? 0) : 0;
      const made = await tx.execute<{ id: string; g: number }>(sql`
        insert into public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, rule_id, alleges_illegal, category, bona_fide, automated_processing, received_at)
        select ${"automated"}::public.intake_kind, r.ref, ${"system"}::public.intake_channel, ${rule}, false, ${RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[rule]}, false, true, ${spread(year)}
          from unnest(${`{${Array.from({ length: n }, () => newRef()).join(",")}}`}::text[]) with ordinality as r(ref, g)
        returning id`);
      // An item on a case has its number in the case; these come after any the year's case holds.
      for (const [at, intake] of made.slice(0, restricted).entries()) {
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.intake_items (intake_id, position, target_type, target_id, case_id, seq, lane, created_at)
                             values (${intake.id}::uuid, 1, 'post', ${postId}::uuid, ${caseId}::uuid, ${100_000 + at}, 2, make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC'))`);
      }
    }
    for (const [rule, n] of Object.entries(cells.automated?.measures ?? {}) as ["R1" | "R2", number][]) {
      const rows = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
        insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                      snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim,
                                      automated_detection, automated_decision)
        select ${caseId}::uuid, 'interim', 0, 'restricted', 'incompatible', ${rule}, 3, 4, ${RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[rule]}, 'own_initiative',
               ${snapshot!.id}::uuid, ${hex64()}, null, ${spread(year)}, '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g::text), ${spread(year)}, false, false, false, true, 'fully'
          from generate_series(1, ${n}::int) g
        returning id`);
      await tx.execute(sql`
        insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id, created_at)
        select d.id, ${rule === "R1" ? "withhold_media" : "seal_media"}::public.action_kind, ${rule === "R1" ? mediaIds[0]! : null}::uuid, ${authorId}::uuid, ${postId}::uuid, d.decided_at
          from public.decisions d where d.id = any(${`{${rows.map((row) => row.id).join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    }

    // An appeal answered in the year: the decision it appeals is of the year before (so no restriction of the year is
    // added), and the review that answers it is of the year, with the result the cell names.
    for (const [result, n] of Object.entries(cells.appeals ?? {}) as ["kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed", number][]) {
      const appealed = await decisions(n, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", at: spread(year - 1), measure });
      for (const decisionId of appealed) {
        const [appeal] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.appeals (decision_id, appellant_account_id, filed_at) values (${decisionId}::uuid, ${authorId}::uuid, make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC')) returning id`);
        const [review] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, reviews_decision_id, appeal_id, seen_state_version, outcome, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                        snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, reason_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
          values (${caseId}::uuid, 'review', ${decisionId}::uuid, ${appeal!.id}::uuid, 0, ${result}::public.decision_outcome, 3, 3, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', 'report',
                  ${snapshot!.id}::uuid, ${hex64()}, ${hex64()}, ${staff.id}::uuid, make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 3, 3, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC'), '1'::xid8, ${randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "")},
                  make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 3, 3, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC'), false, false, false)
          returning id`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.appeals set answered_by = ${review!.id}::uuid, result = ${result}::public.appeal_result, answered_at = make_timestamptz(${year}::int, 3, 3, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC')
                              where id = ${appeal!.id}::uuid`);
      }
    }
  }
  // On again for what follows: a failure above aborted the transaction, which the caller rolls back with the switch.
  for (const table of BULK_TABLES) await tx.execute(sql.raw(`alter table public.${table} enable trigger user`));

  // 3d Task 7: refused uploads. The image row and its match record go through their own triggers; the refusal, written by
  // the hundred in a year as no flow writes it, with its triggers off, so its time and its end are the year's.
  if (cells.uploads) {
    await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.upload_refusals disable trigger user`);
    for (const [label, n] of Object.entries(cells.uploads) as ["report" | "no_report" | "open", number][]) {
      for (let g = 0; g < n; g++) {
        const mediaId = await newImageRow(tx, authorId, null);
        const matchId = await matchForTest(tx, mediaId, "acting");
        const refusedAt = sql`make_timestamptz(${year}::int, ${1 + (g % 11)}::int, ${1 + (g % 28)}::int, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC')`;
        const endedAt = label === "open" ? sql`null::timestamptz` : sql`make_timestamptz(${year}::int, ${2 + (g % 11)}::int, ${1 + (g % 28)}::int, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC')`;
        await tx.execute(sql`
          insert into public.upload_refusals (media_id, owner_id, match_id, refused_at, end_as, end_reason, ended_at, ended_by)
          values (${mediaId}::uuid, ${authorId}::uuid, ${matchId}::uuid, ${refusedAt}, ${label === "open" ? null : label}, ${label === "no_report" ? "other" : null},
                  ${endedAt}, ${label === "open" ? null : staff.id}::uuid)`);
      }
    }
    await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.upload_refusals enable trigger user`);
  }

  const orders: OrderView[] = [];
  for (const cell of cells.orders ?? []) orders.push(await orderOfYear(tx, year, cell, staff));
  return { caseId, orders, spareIds };
}

/**
 * One order of a year, as cli-counts.test.ts's fixture writes one: opened on new posts, its first `effectOn` items given
 * effect, its receipt recorded so many minutes before its last disabling, then every time of it moved back by whole
 * minutes so that its last disabling falls on `disabledAt`. A held one has Section C, so its order decisions are untold,
 * and its hold's recorded end at `heldUntil`.
 */
async function orderOfYear(tx: DbTx, year: number, cell: OrderCell, staff: TestStaff): Promise<OrderView> {
  const posts: string[] = [];
  for (let n = 0; n < cell.posts; n++) posts.push((await imagePost(tx, 1)).postId);
  const order = await orderForTest(tx, staff, { posts, memberState: cell.memberState ?? "DE", sectionC: cell.heldUntil !== undefined });
  const chosen = order.items.slice(0, cell.effectOn ?? order.items.length).map((item) => item.id);
  const view = chosen.length === 0 ? order : await effectWith(tx, staff, order.id, effectParams(order, { itemIds: chosen }));
  if (cell.receivedBefore !== undefined) {
    await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = coalesce((select max(disabled_at) from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid), opened_at)
                                                                     - make_interval(mins => ${cell.receivedBefore}::int)
                          where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
  }
  const target = cell.disabledAt ?? new Date(Date.UTC(year, 5, 15, 12));
  const [last] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select coalesce(max(disabled_at), (select opened_at from public.legal_orders where id = ${order.id}::uuid))::text as at
                                                       from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
  await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, Math.round((new Date(last!.at).getTime() - target.getTime()) / 60_000));
  if (cell.heldUntil !== undefined) {
    await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = ${cell.heldUntil.toISOString()}::timestamptz, hold_end_reason = 'released_by_authority'
                          where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
  }
  return view;
}
```

```ts
  test("witness off: the job's day publishes the row named none, mails the keeper the day, the value, the place and the hash, which give the value again, and writes no audit row", async () => {
    const { module, kept } = build({ HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL: KEEPER });
    const before = await auditHead();
    const round = await module.round();
    expect(round.editions).toEqual([]);
    expect(round.head).toMatchObject({ day: await today(), inserted: true, witnessed: null, published: true, mailed: "sent", alerts: [], done: true });
    // The publication is no audit row: it would move the head it publishes.
    expect((await auditHead()).seq).toBe(before.seq);
    const [row] = await headRows();
    expect({ ...row }).toMatchObject({ day: await today(), kind: "head", chain_seq: before.seq, value: headValue(await today(), before.seq, before.hash), witness: "none", token: null, published: true, retired: false });
    expect(kept()).toHaveLength(1);
    const mail = kept()[0]!;
    expect(mail.to).toBe(KEEPER);
    expect(mail.data).toEqual({ day: await today(), value: row!.value, seq: String(before.seq), hash: before.hash, witnessed: "none" });
    // The keeper's check: the day, the place and the hash give the value.
    expect(headValue(mail.data.day!, Number(mail.data.seq), mail.data.hash!)).toBe(mail.data.value);
    // A later round of the same day writes and mails nothing.
    const later = await module.round();
    expect(later.head).toBeNull();
    expect(kept()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

    expect(mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    const [row] = await headRows();

  });

    const rejecting = new Proxy({}, { get: () => async () => Promise.reject(new Error("the counts store is down")) }) as unknown as SketchStore;
    let asked = 0;

    const d = await today();
```

```ts
    const [found] = await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log where metadata::text like ${`%${salt}%`}`);
    expect(found!.n).toBe(0);
  });

  test("with RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT off nothing of a signed-out reader is kept; and a Valkey that fails never fails a request", async () => {
    await removeKeys();
    const off = build({ RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT: "off" }).app;
    expect((await off.request("/api/timeline/latest")).status).toBe(200);
    await settle();
    expect(await countKeys()).toEqual([]);
    const broken = new Redis("redis://127.0.0.1:1/0", { maxRetriesPerRequest: 0, lazyConnect: true, enableOfflineQueue: false, retryStrategy: () => null });
    broken.on("error", () => undefined);
    const auth = createAuth({ config, logger, authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    const failing = createTransparency({ apiDb, counts: broken, auth: auth.forTransparency, config, logger, now: () => clock });
    auth.onSeen(failing.forAuth);
    const failingApp = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), healthChecks: {}, auth, social: createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth() }), transparency: failing });
    const res = await failingApp.request("/api/timeline/latest");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    await settle();
    broken.disconnect();
  });

  test("the job's round closes the month before: two numbers stored, the month's keys deleted; once a day after the dispatch hour it publishes what edition is due", async () => {
    await removeKeys();
    await removeMonths();
    // April 2009: two accounts seen, one reader on two days.
    const accounts = ["a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1", "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2"];
    // 3d review M10: the job's first round of April marked the month, so its count is whole.
    await markMonth(redis, new Date("2009-04-01T00:05:00.000Z"));
    clock = new Date("2009-04-03T09:00:00.000Z");
    for (const account of accounts) transparency.forAuth.seen(account);
    transparency.forAuth.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", "Mozilla/5.0 Firefox/140.0", "/api/timeline/latest");
    clock = new Date("2009-04-04T09:00:00.000Z");
    transparency.forAuth.seenSignedOut("203.0.113.9", "Mozilla/5.0 Firefox/140.0", "/api/timeline/latest");
    await settle();
    expect(await countKeys()).toEqual(["mau:in:2009-04", "mau:out:2009-04-03", "mau:out:2009-04-04", "mau:salt:2009-04-03", "mau:salt:2009-04-04"]);

    // The first of May, before the dispatch hour: the month closes; no edition is asked for yet.
    clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 1, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR - 1, 30));
    try {
      const first = await transparency.round();
      expect(first).toEqual({ months: ["2009-04"], editions: null, head: null });
      const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ month: string; signed_in: number; signed_out_days: number; method: number; fresh: boolean }>(
        sql`select month::text, signed_in, signed_out_days, method, computed_at > now() - interval '1 minute' as fresh from public.recipient_months where month = '2009-04-01'::date`,
      );
      expect({ ...row }).toEqual({ month: "2009-04-01", signed_in: 2, signed_out_days: 2, method: RECIPIENT_RULES.method, fresh: true });
      expect((await countKeys()).filter((key) => !key.startsWith("mau:salt:"))).toEqual([]);
      expect(await redis.exists(sketchKeys.month("2009-04"))).toBe(0);

      // After the dispatch hour: the last closed year's edition (2008) is due and published once, by the API's role.
      clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 1, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, 5));
      const second = await transparency.round();
      // 3d Task 5: the same daily pass publishes the head's value of the database's today, which writes no audit row.
      expect(second).toMatchObject({ months: [], editions: [{ year: YEAR, version: 1 }], head: { inserted: true, published: true } });
      const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; target_id: string }>(sql`select action, target_id from public.audit_log where chain_seq = (select seq from public.audit_head where id = 1)`);
      expect({ ...audit }).toEqual({ action: "edition_published", target_id: `${YEAR}.1` });
      // Later the same day: nothing more. The next day: asked again, and nothing new is written.
      clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 1, 23, 0));
      expect(await transparency.round()).toEqual({ months: [], editions: null, head: null });
      clock = new Date(Date.UTC(2009, 4, 2, config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR, 5));
      expect(await transparency.round()).toMatchObject({ months: [], editions: [], head: { inserted: false, published: false } });
    } finally {
      clock = new Date("2009-05-17T10:00:00.000Z");
      await removeYear(YEAR);
      await removeMonths();
      await removeKeys();
      await removeHead();
    }
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    await removeYear(YEAR);
    await removeMonths();
    await removeHead();
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.profiles where id = ${since}::uuid`);
    expect(await rowCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
