```ts
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { AccountMailResult, ActiveStaffSession, StaffMessage, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { boundLockWaits, isBoundReached, isDeadlock } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { confirmedAlertRow, mailAlertRow } from "./alerts";
import { decodeListCursor, encodeListCursor } from "./author";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { RETRY_MARGIN_MS } from "./decide";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, iso, raisedMessage, rows, staffCaseConflict, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The release (3d design, sections 6.2, 7.2, 7.14 and 9.6): the one-way end of korbat's keeping of the images of a seal
 * for good, on a leave or an instruction to destroy that the command line recorded, by an admin's confirmed action. The
 * database decides whether it can stand (seal_release, and releases_confirmed at commit); this file reads the release
 * block a case shows, runs the confirmed action's transaction, tells every staff account, and sends the author's notice
 * at once or, while a hold on telling stands, in the dispatch round that finds the last hold ended. It names no image
 * row: the release erases them inside the database's function, and the media module's disposal drops them.
 */

/** A time as ISO text in UTC, to the microsecond, for a list's cursor. */
const microsOf = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')`);

interface FactsRow {
  reported: boolean;
  their_reference: string | null;
  answer: SealRelease["answer"];
  answered_at: string | null;
  handed_over_at: string | null;
  quarantined: boolean;
  preserved: boolean;
  leave_id: string | null;
  leave_from: "authority" | "court" | null;
  leave_reference: string | null;
  leave_received_on: string | null;
  leave_untold: boolean | null;
  leave_untold_until: string | null;
  tell_held: boolean;
}

/** The columns of release_facts and upload_release_facts that are an admin's alone. */
export interface AdminFactsRow {
  their_reference: string | null;
  answer: SealRelease["answer"];
  answered_at: string | null;
  leave_id: string | null;
  leave_from: "authority" | "court" | null;
  leave_reference: string | null;
  leave_received_on: string | null;
  leave_untold: boolean | null;
  leave_untold_until: string | null;
}

/**
 * 3d review M1 (design 11.4): the members of a release block that only an admin is given, the authority's reference, its
 * assessment with its day and the standing leave; for any other session none of them, not even as null, so a moderator
 * never learns them. The other facts (reported, in the quarantine, preserved, whether the notice would be held) stand.
 */
export function adminFacts(admin: boolean, f: AdminFactsRow): Pick<SealRelease, "theirReference" | "answer" | "answeredAt" | "leave"> {
  if (!admin) return {};
  return {
    theirReference: f.their_reference,
    answer: f.answer,
    answeredAt: f.answered_at,
    leave:
      f.leave_id === null
        ? null
        : { id: f.leave_id, from: f.leave_from!, reference: f.leave_reference!, receivedOn: f.leave_received_on!, untold: f.leave_untold === true, untoldUntil: f.leave_untold_until },
  };
}

/**
 * CaseDecision.release (sections 7.2, 8.5 and 10.3) for each of these seals for good in force, keyed by the seal's
 * ledger row: the facts of release_facts, the lowest RELEASE_POSTS_MAX posts of the seal not yet released (which the
 * params the key signs must name), how many more remain, silence_days, and the seal's newest release with its posts and
 * their image rows as the seal counted them.
 */
export async function releaseBlocks(q: Runner, actionIds: readonly string[], admin: boolean): Promise<Map<string, SealRelease>> {
  const blocks = new Map<string, SealRelease>();
  if (actionIds.length === 0) return blocks;
  const [rules] = await rows<{ silence_days: number | null }>(q, sql`select r.silence_days from public.release_rules() r`);
  for (const actionId of actionIds) {
    const [f] = await rows<FactsRow>(
      q,
      sql`select f.reported, f.their_reference, f.answer, ${iso("f.answered_at")} as answered_at, ${iso("f.handed_over_at")} as handed_over_at,
                 f.quarantined, f.preserved, f.leave_id, f.leave_from, f.leave_reference, to_char(f.leave_received_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as leave_received_on,
                 f.leave_untold, ${iso("f.leave_untold_until")} as leave_untold_until, f.tell_held
            from public.release_facts(${actionId}::uuid) f`,
    );
    const open = await rows<{ post_id: string }>(
      q,
      sql`select s.post_id from public.seal_posts s
           where s.action_id = ${actionId}::uuid and not exists (select 1 from public.release_posts r where r.post_id = s.post_id)
           order by s.post_id`,
    );
    const [newest] = await rows<{ released_at: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; backups_clear_at: string; held: boolean }>(
      q,
      sql`select ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at, r.basis, ${iso("r.backups_clear_at")} as backups_clear_at, r.author_notice = 'held' as held
            from public.releases r where r.seal_action_id = ${actionId}::uuid order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc limit 1`,
    );
    const [released] = await rows<{ posts: number; images: number }>(
      q,
      sql`select count(*)::int as posts, coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int as images
            from public.seal_posts s join public.release_posts r on r.post_id = s.post_id where s.action_id = ${actionId}::uuid`,
    );
    const postIds = open.slice(0, RELEASE_POSTS_MAX).map((row) => row.post_id);
    blocks.set(actionId, {
      reported: f!.reported,
      ...adminFacts(admin, f!),
      handedOverAt: f!.handed_over_at,
      quarantined: f!.quarantined,
      preserved: f!.preserved,
      tellHeld: f!.tell_held,
      postIds,
      remaining: open.length - postIds.length,
      silenceDays: rules!.silence_days,
      releasedAt: newest?.released_at ?? null,
      basis: newest?.basis ?? null,
      backupsClearAt: newest?.backups_clear_at ?? null,
      noticeHeld: newest === undefined ? null : newest.held,
      releasedPosts: released!.posts,
      releasedImages: released!.images,
    });
  }
  return blocks;
}

/** The locks a release may wait for: the subject's profile, the case, the leave, the admin's auth row, the image rows and the audit head. */
const RELEASE_WAITS = 6;

/** What a release that committed answers: the seal's case, which the route answers as it now stands. */
export type ReleaseOutcome = { caseId: string; releaseId: string } | "ended" | "late";

/**
 * POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release, once its step-up verified (section 7.2): one transaction on the API's pool,
 * built as recordConfirmed builds a decision's. Every lock wait is bounded by what is left of the challenge; the subject's
 * profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE first, as in every deciding transaction; then seal_release, which takes the seal's case and
 * checks everything in the database's order; last the confirmed audit row seal_released on the seal, with the params as
 * the key confirmed them and the release's id, which releases_confirmed holds the row to at commit. "ended" and "late"
 * as for a decision; once more after a deadlock while the challenge has time. After the commit, unwaited for: the alert
 * seal_released to every staff account and the author's notice, unless it was born held.
 */
export async function releaseSeal(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<ReleaseOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never releases: a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "seal_released" || confirmed.target.type !== "seal" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) throw new Error("a seal is released only with the step-up that confirmed it");
  const params = SealReleasedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const actionId = confirmed.target.id;
  // A ledger row never changes: its subject and its case are read before the transaction, as decide reads a post's author.
  const [seal] = await rows<{ subject: string; case_id: string }>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select a.subject_account_id as subject, d.case_id from public.decision_actions a join public.decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
         where a.id = ${actionId}::uuid and a.kind::text = 'seal_media'`,
  );
  if (seal === undefined) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  // 3d review M2: an admin too close to the seal's subject is refused before anything is written, as every route that
  // names a case refuses (refuseRecused); seal_release refuses it again inside, whatever the API asks first.
  if (await staffCaseConflict(deps.apiDb, session.userId, seal.case_id)) throw new ModerationError("staff_recused");
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const message: StaffMessage = { template: "seal_released", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), posts: params.postIds.length, uploads: 0 } };
      const outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<{ releaseId: string; rowId: number } | "late"> => {
        if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, RELEASE_WAITS))) return "late";
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [seal.subject], "no key update");
        const [row] = await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select public.seal_release(${actionId}::uuid, ${params.basis}, ${params.leaveId}::uuid, ${session.userId}::uuid) as id`);
        // 3d review L1: the alert's row in the release's own transaction, before its audit row: a restart after the commit
        // never loses it.
        const rowId = await confirmedAlertRow(tx, message);
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: session.userId,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "seal_released",
          targetType: "seal",
          targetId: actionId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params, releaseId: row!.id },
          staffSession: session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: ctx.requestId,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        return { releaseId: row!.id, rowId };
      });
      if (outcome === "late") return "late";
      deps.background.start(() => afterRelease(deps, outcome.releaseId, outcome.rowId, message));
      return { caseId: seal.case_id, releaseId: outcome.releaseId };
    } catch (err) {
      const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isBoundReached(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt > 1 || confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS) return "late";
    }
  }
}

/**
 * What follows a release's commit, each part in a try of its own (section 7.2, after the commit): the mail of the alert
 * seal_released to every staff account, the admin who released included, without a throttle (3c gives the milder lifting
 * of a seal the same), from the row the release's transaction wrote (3d review L1); then the author's notice, when it was
 * not born held. Never throws.
 */
async function afterRelease(deps: ModerationDeps, releaseId: string, rowId: number, message: StaffMessage): Promise<void> {
  await mailAlertRow(deps, rowId, message);
  try {
    await sendReleaseNotice(deps, releaseId);
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, releaseId }, "moderation: a release's notice was not sent; the dispatch round sends it");
  }
}

/** A mail's result as the notice's state. A relay that cannot take the mail now throws, and the notice stays pending. */
const NOTICE_STATE: Record<AccountMailResult, "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "failed"> = {
  sent: "sent",
  suppressed: "suppressed",
  no_address: "no_address",
  refused: "failed",
};

/** The release's author: the seal's subject, or for a replay the author of its posts; null when neither is there. */
const AUTHOR = (alias: string) =>
  sql.raw(`coalesce((select a.subject_account_id from public.decision_actions a where a.id = ${alias}.seal_action_id),
                    (select p.author_id from public.posts p where p.id = any(${alias}.post_ids) order by p.id limit 1))`);

/**
 * The view of a release that releaseNoticeParagraphs reads (ReleaseNoticeView), read for anyone or for its author alone
 * with `owner`; null for a release that is not there, not the owner's, or (unless `held` is allowed) whose notice is held.
 * `images` is the image rows the release erased, as the seals counted them (seal_posts.images, which nothing changes).
 */
export async function releaseView(
  q: Runner,
  releaseId: string,
  options: { owner?: string; allowHeld?: boolean; media?: Pick<ModerationDeps["media"], "refusalSubject"> } = {},
): Promise<(ReleaseNoticeView & { authorId: string | null }) | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ id: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; released_at: string; backups_clear_at: string; upload: boolean; upload_refusal_id: string | null; post_ids: string[]; author_id: string | null; held: boolean; seal_decision: string | null; images: number }>(
    q,
    sql`select r.id, r.basis, ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at, ${iso("r.backups_clear_at")} as backups_clear_at, r.upload_refusal_id is not null as upload, r.upload_refusal_id,
               r.post_ids::text[] as post_ids, ${AUTHOR("r")} as author_id, r.author_notice = 'held' as held,
               coalesce((select a.decision_id from public.decision_actions a where a.id = r.seal_action_id),
                        (select a.decision_id from public.seal_posts s join public.decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id
                          where s.post_id = any(r.post_ids) order by a.created_at desc, a.id limit 1)) as seal_decision,
               coalesce((select sum(x.images) from (select max(s.images) as images from public.seal_posts s where s.post_id = any(r.post_ids) group by s.post_id) x), 0)::int as images
          from public.releases r where r.id = ${releaseId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (row === undefined) return null;
  // 3d Task 7: a held upload's release has no seal and no post; its author is the refusal's uploader, read through the
  // media module, which owns the refusals.
  if (row.upload_refusal_id !== null) row.author_id = options.media === undefined ? null : ((await options.media.refusalSubject(q, row.upload_refusal_id))?.ownerId ?? null);
  if (options.owner !== undefined && row.author_id !== options.owner) return null;
  if (row.held && !options.allowHeld) return null;
  const posts = await rows<{ id: string; created_at: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select p.id, ${iso("p.created_at")} as created_at from public.posts p where p.id = any(${`{${row.post_ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) order by p.created_at, p.id limit ${RELEASE_NOTICE_POSTS_MAX}`,
  );
  return {
    id: row.id,
    basis: row.basis,
    releasedAt: row.released_at,
    backupsClearAt: row.backups_clear_at,
    upload: row.upload,
    posts: posts.map((post) => ({ id: post.id, createdAt: post.created_at })),
    postCount: row.post_ids.length,
    images: row.images,
    sealDecisionId: row.seal_decision,
    authorId: row.author_id,
  };
}

/**
 * The author's notice of one release, if it is pending: in a transaction that holds the release's row FOR UPDATE while
 * the mail is sent, so the send after the commit and the dispatch round never both send it. The mail's result is the
 * notice's state; a relay that could not take it leaves it pending for the next round. Answers whether it was sent.
 */
export async function sendReleaseNotice(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth"> & { media?: ModerationDeps["media"] }, releaseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    const [locked] = await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select r.id from public.releases r where r.id = ${releaseId}::uuid and r.author_notice = 'pending' for update`);
    if (locked === undefined) return false;
    const view = await releaseView(tx, releaseId, { allowHeld: false, media: deps.media });
    if (view === null || view.authorId === null) {
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'none', author_notice_at = now() where id = ${releaseId}::uuid`);
      return false;
    }
    const { authorId, ...notice } = view;
    const state = NOTICE_STATE[await deps.auth.mailAccount(authorId, { template: "release_notice", view: notice })];
    await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = ${state}, author_notice_at = now() where id = ${releaseId}::uuid`);
    return state === "sent";
  });
}

/** How many releases' notices one round takes at most. */
const RELEASE_NOTICES_PER_ROUND = 50;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * The dispatch round's releases (sections 7.2 and 7.14): first every held notice whose release the author may now be
 * told of (release_tellable) moves to pending, in the round that finds the last hold ended and never before, and is
 * mailed at once; then every pending notice the send after its commit left (older than `due`) is mailed, or given up
 * after the give-up days of 3c, counted from when it became pending. A row that fails is logged and left as it was.
 * Answers how many were sent.
 */
export async function releaseNotices(deps: ModerationDeps, now: Date, due: Date, logUnsent: (err: unknown, ids: Record<string, string>) => void): Promise<number> {
  let sent = 0;
  const held = await rows<{ id: string }>(deps.apiDb, sql`select r.id from public.releases r where r.author_notice = 'held' order by r.released_at, r.id limit ${RELEASE_NOTICES_PER_ROUND}`);
  for (const { id } of held) {
    try {
      const moved = await rows<{ id: string }>(
        deps.apiDb,
        sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'pending', author_notice_at = now()
             where id = ${id}::uuid and author_notice = 'held' and public.release_tellable(id) returning id`,
      );
      if (moved.length > 0 && (await sendReleaseNotice(deps, id))) sent++;
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(err, { releaseId: id });
    }
  }
  const pending = await rows<{ id: string; since: string }>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select r.id, ${iso("coalesce(r.author_notice_at, r.released_at)")} as since from public.releases r
         where r.author_notice = 'pending' and coalesce(r.author_notice_at, r.released_at) < ${due.toISOString()}::timestamptz
         order by r.released_at, r.id limit ${RELEASE_NOTICES_PER_ROUND}`,
  );
  for (const { id, since } of pending) {
    try {
      if (now.getTime() - Date.parse(since) > RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays * DAY_MS) {
        await deps.apiDb.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'failed', author_notice_at = now() where id = ${id}::uuid and author_notice = 'pending'`);
        deps.log.warn({ kind: "release_notice", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
        continue;
      }
      if (await sendReleaseNotice(deps, id)) sent++;
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(err, { releaseId: id });
    }
  }
  return sent;
}

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/notices (sections 9.6 and 10.2): the releases about the viewer's posts, newest first, 20 a page,
 * never one whose notice is held: nothing of the app shows a release while a hold on telling stands.
 */
export async function authorNotices(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb"> & { media?: Pick<ModerationDeps["media"], "refusalsOf"> }, viewer: string, cursor?: string): Promise<AuthorNoticesPage> {
  const after = cursor === undefined ? null : decodeListCursor(cursor);
  const releases = await rows<{ id: string; at: string; key: string }>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select r.id, ${iso("r.released_at")} as at, ${microsOf("r.released_at")} as key
          from public.releases r
         where r.author_notice <> 'held' and ${AUTHOR("r")} = ${viewer}::uuid
           and (${after === null} or (r.released_at, r.id) < (${after?.at ?? null}::timestamptz, ${after?.id ?? null}::uuid))
         order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc
         limit ${AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE + 1}`,
  );
  // 3d Task 7 (sections 9.5 and 10.2): the viewer's refused uploads beside them, through the media module, merged newest
  // first under the one cursor of (time, id). A held upload's release is told in its own refusal's notice.
  const refusals = deps.media === undefined ? [] : await deps.media.refusalsOf(viewer, after, AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE + 1);
  const found = [...releases.map((row) => ({ ...row, kind: "release" as const })), ...refusals.map((row) => ({ ...row, kind: "upload_refused" as const }))].sort((a, b) =>
    a.key !== b.key ? (a.key < b.key ? 1 : -1) : a.id < b.id ? 1 : a.id > b.id ? -1 : 0,
  );
  const page = found.slice(0, AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE);
  const last = page[page.length - 1];
  return {
    notices: page.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind, id: row.id, at: row.at })),
    nextCursor: found.length > AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE && last ? encodeListCursor({ at: last.key, id: last.id }) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * 3d Task 8 (W.10): the export's `releases`: every release about the account's posts, and every release of one of its
 * refused uploads (given by id: the refusals are the media module's), newest first, each with its ground and its time and
 * whether it was of an upload. Never one whose notice is held: the export says no more than the notices may.
 */
export async function exportedReleases(q: Runner, viewer: string, refusalIds: readonly string[]): Promise<{ id: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; releasedAt: string; upload: boolean }[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ id: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; released_at: string; upload: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select r.id, r.basis, ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at, r.upload_refusal_id is not null as upload
          from public.releases r
         where r.author_notice <> 'held'
           and (${AUTHOR("r")} = ${viewer}::uuid or r.upload_refusal_id = any(${`{${refusalIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]))
         order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, basis: row.basis, releasedAt: row.released_at, upload: row.upload }));
}

/** GET /api/moderation/releases/:release: the notice for its author alone, and not_found while it is held or for anyone else. */
export async function authorRelease(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, viewer: string, releaseId: string): Promise<ReleaseNoticeView> {
  const view = await releaseView(deps.apiDb, releaseId, { owner: viewer });
  if (view === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  const { authorId: _author, ...notice } = view;
  return notice;
}

/**
 * The appeals' mark (sections 7.2 and 8.7): for each of these decisions whose seal has released posts, the newest
 * release's time and ground, keyed by the decision's id.
 */
export async function releasedSeals(q: Runner, decisionIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, { at: string; basis: "leave" | "period" }>> {
  const marks = new Map<string, { at: string; basis: "leave" | "period" }>();
  if (decisionIds.length === 0) return marks;
  const found = await rows<{ decision_id: string; at: string; basis: "leave" | "period" }>(
    q,
    sql`select distinct on (a.decision_id) a.decision_id, ${iso("r.released_at")} as at, r.basis
          from public.decision_actions a join public.releases r on r.seal_action_id = a.id
         where a.decision_id = any(${`{${decisionIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and a.kind::text = 'seal_media'
         order by a.decision_id, r.released_at desc, r.id desc`,
  );
  for (const row of found) marks.set(row.decision_id, { at: row.at, basis: row.basis });
  return marks;
}

/** Home's [home.released] (sections 8.2 and 10.3): the releases of the last DESTRUCTIVE_DAYS, newest first, with their seal's case. */
export async function recentReleases(q: Runner, days: number, max: number): Promise<{ kind: "seal_released"; at: string; caseId: string | null; refusalId: null }[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ at: string; case_id: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select ${iso("r.released_at")} as at, d.case_id
          from public.releases r
          left join public.decision_actions a on a.id = r.seal_action_id
          left join public.decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
         where r.replay_of is null and r.released_at >= now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int)
         order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc limit ${max}`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: "seal_released" as const, at: row.at, caseId: row.case_id, refusalId: null }));
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE,
  UploadHoldEndedParams,
  UploadReleasedParams,
  statementMatchKind,
  type HeldUpload,
  type ObjectionRequest,
  type UploadRefusalView,
  type UploadRelease,
  type UploadsPage,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION, RULES_VERSION, getRedress, getRule, uploadNoticeParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { AccountMailResult, ActiveStaffSession, StaffMessage, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { boundLockWaits, isBoundReached, isDeadlock } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import type { MatchEvent, RefusalRow } from "../media";
import { alertUrgentLane, confirmedAlertRow, mailAlertRow, staffAlert } from "./alerts";
import { matchSignal } from "./automated";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { RETRY_MARGIN_MS } from "./decide";
import { adminFacts, sendReleaseNotice } from "./release";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, iso, raisedMessage, rows } from "./repo";

/**
 * A refused upload (3d design, sections 2 rows 35 to 37, 7.8 step 4, 7.12 and 7.15; W.5, W.7 and W.8; Task 7): what
 * follows a refusal the media module stored, the uploader's notice and "Object", and Held uploads with the hold's two ends
 * and the release of a held upload. A held upload is a record of its own, not a case: its rows are the media module's,
 * read and written through MediaForCases, and its end and release are the database's definer functions, held to the
 * admin's confirmed audit row at commit. Nothing here opens, serves or names an image, a hash or a file.
 */

/** The alert matcher_down is written at once at most once an hour, by the first upload over the limit on refusals (7.8). */
export const MATCHER_DOWN_KEY = "matcher-down";
export const MATCHER_DOWN_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 60_000;

/** The notice's paragraphs, rendered from the view with the rule's current title and the current redress (W.5). */
export function uploadNotice(view: UploadRefusalView): string[] {
  const rule = getRule("R2", RULES_VERSION);
  const redress = getRedress(REDRESS_VERSION);
  if (!rule || !redress) throw new Error("the current rulebook or redress texts lack what a refused upload's notice prints");
  return uploadNoticeParagraphs(view, rule.title, redress);
}

/**
 * UploadRefusalView (10.2) of one of the uploader's refusals, or null for anyone else's: the source and the derived kind of
 * match, the objection, whether one is open (7.12's one rule), the end once it is one (an end as no_report only after its
 * delay), the release's time unless its notice is held, and whether a record of a report names the refusal.
 */
export async function refusalView(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media">, ownerId: string, refusalId: string): Promise<UploadRefusalView | null> {
  const own = await deps.media.refusalOf(ownerId, refusalId);
  if (own === null) return null;
  const [release] =
    own.releaseId === null
      ? []
      : await rows<{ released_at: string }>(deps.apiDb, sql`select ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at from public.releases r where r.id = ${own.releaseId}::uuid and r.author_notice <> 'held'`);
  // The uploader is told of an end as no_report once its delay has passed and it still stands, never earlier.
  const told = own.endAs === "report" || (own.endAs === "no_report" && own.delayPassed);
  return {
    id: own.id,
    refusedAt: own.refusedAt,
    source: own.source,
    matchKind: statementMatchKind(own.hashType, own.matchKind),
    listedAs: "csam",
    objection: own.objection === null || own.objectedAt === null ? null : { text: own.objection, objectedAt: own.objectedAt },
    mayObject: own.objection === null && own.releaseId === null && own.endAs !== "no_report",
    endedAt: told ? own.endedAt : null,
    endAs: told ? own.endAs : null,
    endReason: told ? own.endReason : null,
    released: release?.released_at ?? null,
    reportKept: own.notificationId !== null,
  };
}

/** How many of the uploader's refusals one read of the export takes. */
const EXPORT_REFUSALS_PAGE = 50;

/**
 * 3d Task 8 (W.10): the export's `uploads`: every refusal of the account's uploads, newest first, each as its notice reads
 * it (UploadRefusalView, through the same view the notice's route answers), so the export says what the notice says and
 * no more: no file, no hash, no classification and no list version.
 */
export async function exportedUploads(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media">, ownerId: string): Promise<UploadRefusalView[]> {
  const exported: UploadRefusalView[] = [];
  let after: { at: string; id: string } | null = null;
  for (;;) {
    const page: { id: string; at: string; key: string }[] = await deps.media.refusalsOf(ownerId, after, EXPORT_REFUSALS_PAGE);
    for (const refusal of page) {
      const view = await refusalView(deps, ownerId, refusal.id);
      // A refusal the page has just named is the owner's, unless its record was erased in between: then it names nobody.
      if (view !== null) exported.push(view);
    }
    const last = page.at(-1);
    if (page.length < EXPORT_REFUSALS_PAGE || last === undefined) return exported;
    after = { at: last.key, id: last.id };
  }
}

/** GET /api/moderation/uploads/:refusal: the notice's view for its uploader alone; not_found for anyone else. */
export async function authorUpload(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media">, viewer: string, refusalId: string): Promise<UploadRefusalView> {
  const view = await refusalView(deps, viewer, refusalId);
  if (view === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  return view;
}

/**
 * POST /api/moderation/uploads/:refusal/objection (7.12 step 2): the uploader's one objection, open while the refusal has
 * none, is not released and did not end as no_report; objection_not_open when it changed no row of theirs, not_found for
 * anyone else's. A suspended account may object: no suspension is read here, as for "Ask for a person" (E 7.3). After the
 * commit, unwaited for, the urgent alert counts it among the held uploads. The answer is the notice's view as it now reads.
 */
export async function objectToUpload(deps: ModerationDeps, viewer: string, refusalId: string, request: ObjectionRequest): Promise<UploadRefusalView> {
  const outcome = await deps.media.objectToRefusal(viewer, refusalId, request.text);
  if (outcome === "not_found") throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (outcome === "not_open") throw new ModerationError("objection_not_open");
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    await alertUrgentLane(deps);
  });
  return authorUpload(deps, viewer, refusalId);
}

/** A mail's result as a notice's state. */
const NOTICE_STATE: Record<AccountMailResult, "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "failed"> = { sent: "sent", suppressed: "suppressed", no_address: "no_address", refused: "failed" };

/**
 * The uploader's notice of one refusal (7.12 step 1, W.8 upload_refused): its paragraphs as they stand, mailed through the
 * auth module, and the result recorded, which changes only a notice still pending. A refusal that names nobody any more is
 * `none`. A relay that cannot take the mail throws, and the notice stays pending for the dispatch round.
 */
export async function sendRefusalNotice(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth" | "media">, refusal: { id: string; ownerId: string | null }): Promise<boolean> {
  if (refusal.ownerId === null) {
    await deps.media.refusalTold(refusal.id, "none");
    return false;
  }
  const view = await refusalView(deps, refusal.ownerId, refusal.id);
  if (view === null) {
    await deps.media.refusalTold(refusal.id, "none");
    return false;
  }
  const state = NOTICE_STATE[await deps.auth.mailAccount(refusal.ownerId, { template: "upload_refused", paragraphs: uploadNotice(view) })];
  await deps.media.refusalTold(refusal.id, state);
  return state === "sent";
}

/** The notice that a hold ended as no_report was lifted (W.8 upload_hold_lifted): the end's paragraph alone. */
async function sendLiftedNotice(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth" | "media">, refusal: { id: string; ownerId: string | null }): Promise<boolean> {
  const view = refusal.ownerId === null ? null : await refusalView(deps, refusal.ownerId, refusal.id);
  if (refusal.ownerId === null || view === null || view.endAs !== "no_report") {
    await deps.media.liftedTold(refusal.id, "none");
    return false;
  }
  const ended = uploadNotice(view).filter((paragraph) => paragraph.startsWith("An admin ended the hold"));
  const state = NOTICE_STATE[await deps.auth.mailAccount(refusal.ownerId, { template: "upload_hold_lifted", paragraphs: ended })];
  await deps.media.liftedTold(refusal.id, state);
  return state === "sent";
}

/** How many refusals' notices one dispatch round takes at most of each kind. */
const NOTICES_PER_ROUND = 50;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * The dispatch round's notices of refused uploads (7.14): every refusal's notice the send after its commit left (older
 * than `due`), and every notice that a hold was lifted whose delay has passed; each given up after the give-up days of 3c,
 * counted from the refusal or from the end. Each row in a try of its own, logged by its id. Answers how many were sent.
 */
export async function refusalNotices(deps: ModerationDeps, now: Date, due: Date, giveUpDays: number, logUnsent: (err: unknown, ids: Record<string, string>) => void): Promise<number> {
  let sent = 0;
  for (const refusal of await deps.media.refusalsUntold(NOTICES_PER_ROUND)) {
    if (Date.parse(refusal.refusedAt) >= due.getTime()) continue;
    try {
      if (now.getTime() - Date.parse(refusal.refusedAt) > giveUpDays * DAY_MS) {
        await deps.media.refusalTold(refusal.id, "failed");
        deps.log.warn({ kind: "upload_refused", id: refusal.id }, "moderation: mail given up");
        continue;
      }
      if (await sendRefusalNotice(deps, refusal)) sent++;
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(err, { refusalId: refusal.id });
    }
  }
  for (const refusal of await deps.media.liftedUntold(NOTICES_PER_ROUND)) {
    try {
      if (now.getTime() - Date.parse(refusal.endedAt) > giveUpDays * DAY_MS) {
        await deps.media.liftedTold(refusal.id, "failed");
        deps.log.warn({ kind: "upload_hold_lifted", id: refusal.id }, "moderation: mail given up");
        continue;
      }
      if (await sendLiftedNotice(deps, refusal)) sent++;
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(err, { refusalId: refusal.id });
    }
  }
  return sent;
}

/**
 * media.onMatch's handler (section 5, 7.8 step 4, 7.9): after the commit that stored a refusal, the uploader's notice and
 * the urgent alert, whose count now includes the held uploads; after the commit that stored a match of an image on a post,
 * the automated step; and for the first upload of an hour over the limit on refusals, matcher_down at once with its facts.
 * Each in a try of its own: a lost call is found by the dispatch round or the automated sweep.
 */
export function matchedHandler(deps: ModerationDeps): (event: MatchEvent) => Promise<void> {
  return async (event) => {
    if (event.kind === "refused") {
      try {
        const [subject] = [await deps.media.refusalSubject(deps.apiDb, event.refusalId)];
        if (subject) await sendRefusalNotice(deps, { id: event.refusalId, ownerId: subject.ownerId });
      } catch (err) {
        deps.log.warn({ err, refusalId: event.refusalId }, "moderation: a refused upload's notice was not mailed; it stays pending for the dispatch job");
      }
      try {
        await alertUrgentLane(deps);
      } catch (err) {
        deps.log.error({ err, refusalId: event.refusalId }, "moderation: the urgent alert for a held upload was not sent; the dispatch round repeats it");
      }
      return;
    }
    if (event.kind === "posted") {
      await matchSignal(deps, { mediaId: event.mediaId, matchId: event.matchId });
      return;
    }
    const counts = await deps.media.checkCounts();
    await staffAlert(deps, MATCHER_DOWN_KEY, MATCHER_DOWN_WINDOW_MS, {
      template: "matcher_down",
      facts: { since: counts.oldestUnchecked ?? deps.now().toISOString(), count: counts.unchecked, refusalsCapped: counts.capped },
    });
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Held uploads (7.12 steps 3 to 5, 8.6)

type FactsRow = {
  reported: boolean;
  their_reference: string | null;
  answer: UploadRelease["answer"];
  answered_at: string | null;
  handed_over_at: string | null;
  quarantined: boolean;
  leave_id: string | null;
  leave_from: "authority" | "court" | null;
  leave_reference: string | null;
  leave_received_on: string | null;
  leave_untold: boolean | null;
  leave_untold_until: string | null;
  tell_held: boolean;
};

/** The release block of a hold ended as report (8.6, 10.3), read through upload_release_facts and the refusal's release. */
async function releaseBlock(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, refusal: RefusalRow, admin: boolean): Promise<UploadRelease | null> {
  if (refusal.endAs !== "report") return null;
  const [f] = await rows<FactsRow>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select f.reported, f.their_reference, f.answer, ${iso("f.answered_at")} as answered_at, ${iso("f.handed_over_at")} as handed_over_at, f.quarantined,
               f.leave_id, f.leave_from, f.leave_reference, to_char(f.leave_received_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as leave_received_on, f.leave_untold,
               ${iso("f.leave_untold_until")} as leave_untold_until, f.tell_held
          from public.upload_release_facts(${refusal.id}::uuid) f`,
  );
  const [rules] = await rows<{ silence_days: number | null }>(deps.apiDb, sql`select r.silence_days from public.release_rules() r`);
  const [release] =
    refusal.releaseId === null
      ? []
      : await rows<{ released_at: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; backups_clear_at: string; held: boolean }>(
          deps.apiDb,
          sql`select ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at, r.basis, ${iso("r.backups_clear_at")} as backups_clear_at, r.author_notice = 'held' as held from public.releases r where r.id = ${refusal.releaseId}::uuid`,
        );
  return {
    reported: f!.reported,
    // 3d review M1: the authority's reference and assessment and the leave are an admin's alone.
    ...adminFacts(admin, f!),
    handedOverAt: f!.handed_over_at,
    quarantined: f!.quarantined,
    tellHeld: f!.tell_held,
    silenceDays: rules!.silence_days,
    releasedAt: release?.released_at ?? null,
    basis: release?.basis ?? null,
    backupsClearAt: release?.backups_clear_at ?? null,
    noticeHeld: release === undefined ? null : release.held,
  };
}

async function heldUpload(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, refusal: RefusalRow, admin: boolean): Promise<HeldUpload> {
  return {
    id: refusal.id,
    refusedAt: refusal.refusedAt,
    match: refusal.match,
    // 3d review M1: the one thing given about the uploader is the admin's (11.4); absent for any other session.
    ...(admin ? { otherRefusals: refusal.otherRefusals } : {}),
    uploaderGone: refusal.uploaderGone,
    objection: refusal.objection,
    objectedAt: refusal.objectedAt,
    endedAt: refusal.endedAt,
    endAs: refusal.endAs,
    endReason: refusal.endReason,
    deletesAt: refusal.deletesAt,
    reported: refusal.reported,
    quarantined: refusal.quarantined,
    release: await releaseBlock(deps, refusal, admin),
  };
}

/** Held uploads' cursor: the offset of the page after, as decimal digits. */
const UPLOADS_CURSOR = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,6})$/;

/** GET /api/staff/uploads (7.12 step 3, 10.3): a page of Held uploads in its sections' order. */
export async function heldUploads(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media">, session: ActiveStaffSession, cursor?: string): Promise<UploadsPage> {
  if (cursor !== undefined && !UPLOADS_CURSOR.test(cursor)) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  const offset = cursor === undefined ? 0 : Number(cursor);
  const found = await deps.media.heldList(offset);
  const page = found.slice(0, UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE);
  const admin = session.role === "admin";
  return { uploads: await Promise.all(page.map((refusal) => heldUpload(deps, refusal, admin))), nextCursor: found.length > UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE ? String(offset + UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE) : null };
}

/** One held upload as the list shows it, the answer of the hold's end and of a release; not_found when there is none. */
export async function heldUploadOf(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media">, refusalId: string, admin: boolean): Promise<HeldUpload> {
  const refusal = await deps.media.held(refusalId);
  if (refusal === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  return heldUpload(deps, refusal, admin);
}

/** The locks an end or a release may wait for: the uploader's profile, the refusal, the image row, the admin's auth row, the leave and the audit head. */
const HOLD_WAITS = 6;

/**
 * One confirmed transaction of Held uploads (7.12 steps 4 and 5), built as a release's: every lock wait bounded by what is
 * left of the challenge; the uploader's profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE when the refusal still names one; the database's
 * function; and last the confirmed audit row, whose metadata names the refusal's image. "ended" and "late" as for a
 * decision; once more after a deadlock while the challenge has time. A refusal of the database's is its own code.
 */
async function confirmedHold<T>(
  deps: ModerationDeps,
  confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed,
  refusalId: string,
  run: (tx: Parameters<Parameters<ModerationDeps["apiDb"]["transaction"]>[0]>[0], mediaId: string) => Promise<T>,
): Promise<T | "ended" | "late"> {
  const subject = await deps.media.refusalSubject(deps.apiDb, refusalId);
  if (subject === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<T | "late"> => {
        if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, HOLD_WAITS))) return "late";
        if (subject.ownerId !== null) await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [subject.ownerId], "no key update");
        return run(tx, subject.mediaId);
      });
      return outcome;
    } catch (err) {
      const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isBoundReached(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt > 1 || confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS) return "late";
    }
  }
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/uploads/:refusal/end (7.12 step 4), once its step-up verified: upload_hold_end, then the confirmed audit
 * row upload_hold_ended on the refusal with the params and the image's id, which upload_refusals_confirmed holds the end to
 * at commit. After an end as no_report every staff account is alerted, the admin included, without a throttle
 * (hold_ended_unreported, with when the upload is deleted). The answer is the refusal as Held uploads now shows it.
 */
export async function endHold(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<HeldUpload | "ended" | "late"> {
  if (confirmed.action !== "upload_hold_ended" || confirmed.target.type !== "upload_refusal" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) throw new Error("a hold is ended only with the step-up that confirmed it");
  const params = UploadHoldEndedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const refusalId = confirmed.target.id;
  const outcome = await confirmedHold(deps, confirmed, refusalId, async (tx, mediaId) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`select public.upload_hold_end(${refusalId}::uuid, ${params.endAs}, ${params.reason}, ${session.userId}::uuid)`);
    // 3d review L1: an end as no_report writes its alert's row here, before the audit row, so a restart after the commit
    // never deletes the upload unannounced; its time of deletion is the one upload_hold_end set (now() and no_report_hours).
    let alert: { rowId: number; message: StaffMessage } | null = null;
    if (params.endAs === "no_report") {
      const [due] = await rows<{ at: string }>(tx, sql`select ${iso("(now() + make_interval(hours => r.no_report_hours))")} as at from public.automation_rules() r`);
      const message: StaffMessage = { template: "hold_ended_unreported", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), deletesAt: due!.at } };
      alert = { rowId: await confirmedAlertRow(tx, message), message };
    }
    await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
      actorId: session.userId,
      keyId: confirmed.keyId,
      action: "upload_hold_ended",
      targetType: "upload_refusal",
      targetId: refusalId,
      metadata: { params: confirmed.params, mediaId },
      staffSession: session.handle,
      actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
      stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
      requestId: ctx.requestId,
      expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
    });
    return alert;
  });
  if (outcome === "ended" || outcome === "late") return outcome;
  const held = await heldUploadOf(deps, refusalId, session.role === "admin");
  if (outcome !== null) {
    const alert = outcome;
    deps.background.start(() => mailAlertRow(deps, alert.rowId, alert.message));
  }
  return held;
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/uploads/:refusal/release (7.12 step 5): upload_release, then the confirmed audit row upload_released on
 * the refusal with the params, the release's id and the image's id, which releases_confirmed holds the release to at
 * commit. After the commit: seal_released to every staff account, the admin included, without a throttle, and the
 * uploader's notice unless it was born held.
 */
export async function releaseUpload(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<HeldUpload | "ended" | "late"> {
  if (confirmed.action !== "upload_released" || confirmed.target.type !== "upload_refusal" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) throw new Error("a held upload is released only with the step-up that confirmed it");
  const params = UploadReleasedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const refusalId = confirmed.target.id;
  const message: StaffMessage = { template: "seal_released", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), posts: 0, uploads: 1 } };
  const outcome = await confirmedHold(deps, confirmed, refusalId, async (tx, mediaId) => {
    const [row] = await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select public.upload_release(${refusalId}::uuid, ${params.basis}, ${params.leaveId}::uuid, ${session.userId}::uuid) as id`);
    // 3d review L1: the alert's row in the release's own transaction, before its audit row.
    const rowId = await confirmedAlertRow(tx, message);
    await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
      actorId: session.userId,
      keyId: confirmed.keyId,
      action: "upload_released",
      targetType: "upload_refusal",
      targetId: refusalId,
      metadata: { params: confirmed.params, releaseId: row!.id, mediaId },
      staffSession: session.handle,
      actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
      stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
      requestId: ctx.requestId,
      expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
    });
    return { releaseId: row!.id, rowId };
  });
  if (outcome === "ended" || outcome === "late") return outcome;
  const { releaseId, rowId } = outcome;
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    await mailAlertRow(deps, rowId, message);
    try {
      await sendReleaseNotice(deps, releaseId);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, releaseId }, "moderation: a held upload's release notice was not sent; the dispatch round sends it");
    }
  });
  return heldUploadOf(deps, refusalId, session.role === "admin");
}
```

```ts
import { Readable } from "node:stream";
import { AppealsQuery, FindingRequest, MEDIA_SIZES, MediaId, QueueQuery, StaffTextSaveRequest, UploadsQuery } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Hono, type Context } from "hono";
import { z } from "zod";
import { AuthError, type ActiveStaffSession, type AuthForStaff, type StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import type { AppEnv } from "../env";
import { validate } from "../lib/validate";
import type { ModerationForStaff } from "../moderation";

/** A case's id in a path, in the lower case the database writes: a read finds the case by value whatever the spelling. */
const CaseId = z.uuid().transform((id) => id.toLowerCase());
const CaseParam = z.object({ case: CaseId });
/**
 * 3f Task 6 (sections 7.17 step 6 and 10.2): the restore gap a decision or a review takes again, as the query member
 * `gap`: a lower-case uuid, or absent. The transaction closes it with the decision; gap_mismatch when it does not fit.
 */
const GapQuery = z.object({ gap: z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/, { message: "a uuid in lower case" }).optional() });
const ImageParam = z.object({ case: CaseId, media: MediaId, size: z.enum(MEDIA_SIZES) });

/**
 * The console's case routes (3c design, sections 5 and 7), a route group the staff routes mount behind the staff gate.
 * Each stands behind requireStaff; one that changes something a user sees, or that cannot be undone, stands behind
 * requireStaffStepUp as well, which verifies the key's confirmation of exactly what the route is about to do. Three
 * writing routes stand without it, by name: saving a text, taking a fresh snapshot and opening a finding. None of them
 * changes anything a user sees, and each enters the record only through a confirmed decision that names its digest or
 * its case. The handlers only call the moderation module's staff interface and shape the answer: the step-up stays the
 * auth module's, the cases the moderation module's.
 */
export function caseRoutes(auth: AuthForStaff, moderation: ModerationForStaff) {
  const routes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  /** The session requireStaff read; a route without it in front is a wiring fault, not a refusal. */
  const staffSession = (c: Context<AppEnv>): ActiveStaffSession => {
    const session = c.get("staffSession");
    if (!session) throw new Error("a staff route ran without requireStaff");
    return session;
  };

  /** The confirmation requireStaffStepUp verified; a route without it in front is a wiring fault, not a refusal. */
  const confirmedStepUp = (c: Context<AppEnv>): StaffStepUpConfirmed => {
    const confirmed = c.get("staffStepUp");
    if (!confirmed) throw new Error("a staff route that changes something ran without requireStaffStepUp");
    return confirmed;
  };

  // The home screen's numbers, the same for every staff member but one: how many appeals this person may review.
  routes.get("/overview", auth.requireStaff, async (c) => c.json(await moderation.overview(staffSession(c))));

  // Open cases by lane and age. The console refreshes it without the activity mark.
  routes.get("/queue", auth.requireStaff, validate("query", QueueQuery), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.queue(c.req.valid("query").cursor)));

  // 3e: the Standing screen's four lists, read only: no list is a queue key, and people are handles.
  routes.get("/standing", auth.requireStaff, async (c) => c.json(await moderation.standing()));

  // A moderator's own finding opens a case, or joins the target's open one: a named exception to the step-up.
  routes.post("/findings", auth.requireStaff, validate("json", FindingRequest), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.openFinding(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("json")), 201));

  // The case. Every read is written to the access log and held to the day's limit on different cases.
  routes.get("/cases/:case", auth.requireStaff, validate("param", CaseParam), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.caseView(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("param").case)));

  // An image of the case's post, on the console's own origin: the only way an image reaches the console. The moderation
  // module answers a file only when the image may be shown to staff at all and is this case's; every refusal is one 404.
  // Never stored anywhere, and always WebP, whatever the bytes are: the store's files are checked before they are
  // handed over, and nosniff with the API's own policy keeps them inert. A HEAD request never gets here: the staff group
  // answers it before any route, so no file is opened and no view logged for a request that shows nothing.
  routes.get("/cases/:case/media/:media/:size", auth.requireStaff, validate("param", ImageParam), async (c) => {
    const { case: caseId, media, size } = c.req.valid("param");
    const file = await moderation.caseImage(staffSession(c), caseId, media, size);
    c.header("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
    c.header("Content-Type", "image/webp");
    c.header("Content-Length", String(file.size));
    // The stream closes the handle when it ends or fails.
    return c.body(Readable.toWeb(file.handle.createReadStream()) as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>);
  });

  // A fresh snapshot of the case's target as it stands: a named exception to the step-up. It answers an id and a digest,
  // never content, so every read of a case's content goes through the case's own route.
  routes.post("/cases/:case/snapshots", auth.requireStaff, validate("param", CaseParam), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.takeSnapshot(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("param").case)));

  // Saving a text: a named exception to the step-up. The text enters the record only when a confirmed decision or reveal
  // names its digest; a note and a recorded choice not to seal are complete when saved.
  routes.post("/cases/:case/texts", auth.requireStaff, validate("param", CaseParam), validate("json", StaffTextSaveRequest), async (c) =>
    c.json(await moderation.saveText(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("param").case, c.req.valid("json")), 201),
  );
  // The person's own drafts on the case, with their salts.
  routes.get("/cases/:case/texts", auth.requireStaff, validate("param", CaseParam), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.texts(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("param").case)));

  // A decision on a case: the path's case is the action's target, and the body is the action's params with the assertion
  // as `stepUp`. The decision commits with its audit row or not at all. When the confirming key or account no longer
  // opens anything by then, the session that confirmed has ended, and requireStaff clears both cookies on that answer as
  // on its own; when the challenge's time ran out, the console asks for the key again. The answer is the case as it now
  // stands, so the console shows what the decision left; the case is the one the step-up confirmed.
  routes.post(
    "/cases/:case/decisions",
    auth.requireStaff,
    validate("query", GapQuery),
    auth.requireStaffStepUp("case_decided", (c) => c.req.param("case")),
    async (c) => {
      const outcome = await moderation.decide(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c), { requestId: c.get("requestId"), gap: c.req.valid("query").gap ?? null });
      if (outcome === "ended") throw new AuthError("staff_session_required", 401);
      if (outcome === "late") throw new AuthError("challenge_expired", 400);
      return c.json(await moderation.decidedCase(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c).target.id), 201);
    },
  );

  // The pending appeals, newest first, each marked whether this person may review it. No row carries the appellant's
  // statement: it is read on the case page, whose read is logged and counted.
  routes.get("/appeals", auth.requireStaff, validate("query", AppealsQuery), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.appeals(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("query").cursor)));

  // The review of an appeal: the path's decision is the action's target (the decision that was appealed), and the body
  // is the action's params with the assertion as `stepUp`. The review commits with its audit row or not at all, and an
  // ended confirmation and a late one answer as a decision's do. The answer is the decision's case as it now stands.
  routes.post(
    "/decisions/:decision/review",
    auth.requireStaff,
    validate("query", GapQuery),
    auth.requireStaffStepUp("appeals_reviewed", (c) => c.req.param("decision")),
    async (c) => {
      const outcome = await moderation.review(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c), { requestId: c.get("requestId"), gap: c.req.valid("query").gap ?? null });
      if (outcome === "ended") throw new AuthError("staff_session_required", 401);
      if (outcome === "late") throw new AuthError("challenge_expired", 400);
      return c.json(await moderation.reviewedCase(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c).target.id), 201);
    },
  );

  // 3d Task 2 (sections 7.2 and 10.4): an admin's release of a seal for good. The path's seal (its ledger row) is the
  // action's target, and the body the params of seal_released with the assertion as `stepUp`: the lowest unreleased
  // posts as the page showed them, the ground, and the recorded leave by its id with its reference. The release commits
  // with its audit row or not at all; an ended confirmation and a late one answer as a decision's do. The answer is the
  // seal's case as it now stands.
  routes.post(
    "/seals/:action/release",
    auth.requireStaff,
    auth.requireStaffStepUp("seal_released", (c) => c.req.param("action")),
    async (c) => {
      const outcome = await moderation.release(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c), { requestId: c.get("requestId") });
      if (outcome === "ended") throw new AuthError("staff_session_required", 401);
      if (outcome === "late") throw new AuthError("challenge_expired", 400);
      return c.json(await moderation.decidedCase(staffSession(c), outcome.caseId), 201);
    },
  );

  // 3d Task 7 (sections 7.12, 8.6 and 10.3): Held uploads, for every staff member: the refusals in their sections' order,
  // never an image, a hash, a file's name or a handle. The two ends of a hold and the release of a held upload are an
  // admin's (the database refuses anyone else, admin_required): the path's refusal is the action's target, and the body the
  // params of upload_hold_ended or upload_released with the assertion as `stepUp`. Each commits with its audit row or not
  // at all; an ended confirmation and a late one answer as a decision's do. The answer is the refusal as it now shows.
  routes.get("/uploads", auth.requireStaff, validate("query", UploadsQuery), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.uploads(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("query").cursor)));
  routes.post(
    "/uploads/:refusal/end",
    auth.requireStaff,
    auth.requireStaffStepUp("upload_hold_ended", (c) => c.req.param("refusal")),
    async (c) => {
      const outcome = await moderation.endHold(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c), { requestId: c.get("requestId") });
      if (outcome === "ended") throw new AuthError("staff_session_required", 401);
      if (outcome === "late") throw new AuthError("challenge_expired", 400);
      return c.json(outcome, 201);
    },
  );
  routes.post(
    "/uploads/:refusal/release",
    auth.requireStaff,
    auth.requireStaffStepUp("upload_released", (c) => c.req.param("refusal")),
    async (c) => {
      const outcome = await moderation.releaseUpload(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c), { requestId: c.get("requestId") });
      if (outcome === "ended") throw new AuthError("staff_session_required", 401);
      if (outcome === "late") throw new AuthError("challenge_expired", 400);
      return c.json(outcome, 201);
    },
  );

  // Who sent an item: the path's item is the action's target, and the body is the reason's category and the digest of
  // the saved reason, with the assertion as `stepUp`. The access row and the audit row commit together or not at all, and
  // the identity is read only after that commit. An ended confirmation and a late one answer as a decision's do.
  routes.post(
    "/items/:item/reveal",
    auth.requireStaff,
    auth.requireStaffStepUp("identity_revealed", (c) => c.req.param("item")),
    async (c) => {
      const outcome = await moderation.reveal(staffSession(c), confirmedStepUp(c), { requestId: c.get("requestId") });
      if (outcome === "ended") throw new AuthError("staff_session_required", 401);
      if (outcome === "late") throw new AuthError("challenge_expired", 400);
      return c.json(outcome);
    },
  );

  return routes;
}
```

```ts
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import { HEAD_RULES, type HeadKind, type HeadWitness, type PublicHead } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { KeeperMailResult, KeeperMessage } from "../auth";
import type { TransparencyRepo } from "./repo";
import type { WitnessAdapter } from "./witness";

/**
 * The audit head's daily value (3d design, sections 2 row 9, 6.5, 7.7 and 10.6; Task 5). Once a day after the dispatch
 * hour the transparency job inserts the day's row of head_publications, whose insert trigger forces the day, the place
 * and the value from audit_head, so the API's role cannot publish a value of its own making; asks the witness for a token
 * while one is on; sets published_at from null; and mails the keeper, once, from the round whose update published it,
 * the day, the value, the place and the hash, from which the keeper computes the value again. A later round of the same
 * day asks the witness again while the token is null. The day's first round alerts head_missed when the day before has
 * no published value. The publication writes no audit row: it would move the head it publishes (section 15, 3a).
 * 3d review M13: the row records when the relay accepted the keeper's mail (keeper_mailed_at); while a keeper's address
 * is set and none was accepted, each later round of the day mails again, and the next day's first round alerts
 * head_unmailed for a value whose mail never went.
 */

/** The line feed between the digest's four parts. */
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * head_value() of the database, in the API's own code: the hex SHA-256 of the tag, the day (yyyy-mm-dd, UTC), the place
 * in decimal and the hash, each after a line feed. What the keeper computes from the mail; a test holds the two equal.
 */
export function headValue(day: string, seq: number, hash: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update([HEAD_RULES.tag, day, String(seq), hash].join(LF), "utf8").digest("hex");
}

/** The day's head row as the job reads it after its insert. */
export interface HeadToday {
  /** Whether this round's insert wrote it. */
  inserted: boolean;
  day: string;
  value: string;
  witness: HeadWitness;
  witnessed: boolean;
  published: boolean;
  /** 3d review M13: whether the relay accepted the keeper's mail of this value (keeper_mailed_at is set). */
  mailed: boolean;
}

/** One published row as the public route reads it: never its place. */
export interface HeadDayRow {
  day: string;
  kind: HeadKind;
  value: string;
  witness: HeadWitness;
  token: Uint8Array | null;
  retiredOn: string | null;
  lastDay: string | null;
}

/** The statements of the head's day, which repo.ts writes. */
export type HeadRepo = Pick<TransparencyRepo, "headInsert" | "headWitnessed" | "headPublish" | "headPlace" | "headMissed" | "headAlert" | "headMailed" | "headUnmailed">;

/** What one round's pass did with the day's value. */
export interface HeadPass {
  /** The database's UTC day, whose row the pass read. */
  day: string;
  inserted: boolean;
  /** stored: a token came this round; unanswered: the witness was asked and gave none; null: nobody was asked. */
  witnessed: "stored" | "unanswered" | null;
  /** Whether this round's update published the value. */
  published: boolean;
  /**
   * The keeper's mail, from the round that published or (3d review M13) a later round of the day while it is owed: as
   * mailKeeper answered, or unverified when no hash gave the value.

  mailed: KeeperMailResult | "unverified" | null;
  /** The alerts this round wrote (each under F's daily rule, so a second in 24 hours is not written). */
  alerts: ("head_unwitnessed" | "head_missed" | "head_unmailed")[];
  /** Nothing more to do today: published, witnessed or never to be, and the keeper's mail accepted or never to be. */
  done: boolean;
}

export interface HeadDeps {
  repo: HeadRepo;
  witness: WitnessAdapter;
  /** The auth module's mail to HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL, which answers "off" while the setting is empty. */
  mailKeeper: (message: KeeperMessage) => Promise<KeeperMailResult>;

  /** 3d review M13: whether HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL is set, so a mail that did not go is owed. */

/** One round's pass over the day's value (7.7 steps 2 to 6). */
export async function publishHead(deps: HeadDeps, options: { firstOfDay: boolean }): Promise<HeadPass> {
  const { repo, witness, log } = deps;
  const alerts: HeadPass["alerts"] = [];

  const today = await repo.headInsert(witness.name);
  // 6. A missed day: the day before has no published value, while an earlier day has one (the head's first day misses
  // nothing). A missed day is never written afterwards: the page shows the hole.
  if (options.firstOfDay) {
    const missed = await repo.headMissed();
    if (missed !== null && (await repo.headAlert("head_missed", missed))) alerts.push("head_missed");
    // 3d review M13: the day before's value whose keeper's mail never went out, while an address is set.
    if (deps.keeper) {
      const unmailed = await repo.headUnmailed();
      if (unmailed !== null && (await repo.headAlert("head_unmailed", unmailed))) alerts.push("head_unmailed");
    }
  }
  // 3. The witness, while one is on and the row was born under it: a row named none was asked of nobody, and the CHECK
  // keeps a token off it. Asked again in each round while the token is null; a later token proves the value from then on.
  let witnessed: HeadPass["witnessed"] = null;
  let hasToken = today.witnessed;
  if (witness.mode !== "off" && today.witness === witness.name && !today.witnessed) {
    const token = await witness.witness(today.value);
    if (token !== null) {
      // Set from null alone: the update finds nothing when the row has its token already.
      await repo.headWitnessed(today.day, token);
      witnessed = "stored";
      hasToken = true;
    } else {
      witnessed = "unanswered";
      if (await repo.headAlert("head_unwitnessed", today.day)) alerts.push("head_unwitnessed");
      log.warn({ job: "transparency", day: today.day }, "transparency: the head's witness gave no token; the value is published without one");
    }
  }
  // 4. Published, from null, once.
  let published = false;
  if (!today.published) {
    const set = await repo.headPublish(today.day);
    if (set !== null) published = true;
  }
  // 5. The keeper's mail: from the round that published, and (3d review M13) from each later round of the day while an
  // address is set and the relay accepted none. The place's hash is read again and must give the stored value, so the
  // keeper is never sent a place and a hash that do not check.
  let mailed: HeadPass["mailed"] = null;
  if ((today.published || published) && !today.mailed && (published || deps.keeper)) {
    const place = await repo.headPlace(today.day);
    if (place === null) {
      mailed = "unverified";
      log.error({ job: "transparency", day: today.day }, "transparency: no hash of the audit log gives the head's stored value; the keeper is not mailed");
    } else {
      mailed = await deps.mailKeeper({ template: "head_published", day: today.day, value: today.value, seq: place.seq, hash: place.hash, witnessed: hasToken });
      if (mailed === "sent") await repo.headMailed(today.day);
    }
  }
  if (published) log.info({ job: "transparency", day: today.day, mailed }, "transparency: the head's daily value was published");
  const unwitnessable = witness.mode === "off" || today.witness !== witness.name;
  // A refused address and a value no hash gives are not retried: no later try changes either, and the next day's alert
  // head_unmailed says so. A failure is retried in the day's later rounds.
  const mailDone = !deps.keeper || today.mailed || mailed === "sent" || mailed === "refused" || mailed === "unverified";
  return { day: today.day, inserted: today.inserted, witnessed, published, mailed, alerts, done: (today.published || published) && (unwitnessable || hasToken) && mailDone };
}

/** A token as the public answer carries it. */
const base64 = (token: Uint8Array) => Buffer.from(token).toString("base64");

/**
 * GET /api/public/head's answer (10.6): the rows as the route read them, newest first, a row without a token read as
 * witnessed by nobody whatever was asked, the token as base64. It holds no place and no hash.
 */
export function publicHead(rows: readonly HeadDayRow[]): PublicHead {
  return {
    days: rows.map((row) => ({
      day: row.day,
      kind: row.kind,
      value: row.value,
      witness: row.token === null ? "none" : row.witness,
      token: row.token === null ? null : base64(row.token),
      retiredOn: row.retiredOn,
      lastDay: row.lastDay,
    })),
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The transparency module (3d design, sections 4 rows 4 and 5, 5, 7.5, 7.6, 7.7 and 7.14; Tasks 4 and 5): the public
 * figures, the audit head's daily value and the public answers. The only file outside src/transparency/ may import; it
 * reads no session and no table of a person, and the architecture test holds every file of it to the names of

 *     once both modules exist) and the month's close;
 *   - the yearly edition: the daily call of edition_publish() for the last closed year and every earlier year with one;
 *   - the head's daily value (Task 5): the day's row of head_publications, the witness adapter (witness.ts, HEAD_WITNESS)
 *     and the keeper's mail through the auth module's mailKeeper (AuthForTransparency);
 *   - GET /api/public/facts, GET /api/public/transparency and GET /api/public/head;
 *   - one job, `transparency`, every ten minutes under the jobs' shared lock: the month's close each round, and after
 *     MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR the editions once a day and the head in each round until the day's value is published and
 *     witnessed, or needs no witness. Each daily part is idempotent by its table's key, so a round after a restart that
 *     runs it again writes nothing.

import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { AuthForTransparency } from "../auth";
import type { Config } from "../config";
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import { publishEditions } from "./editions";
import { publishHead, type HeadPass } from "./head";
import { closeMonths, createRecipientCounter, markMonth, type RecipientCounter, type SketchStore } from "./recipients";
import { createTransparencyRepo, type TransparencyRepo } from "./repo";
import { publicFacts, transparencyRoutes } from "./routes";
import { witnessFrom, type WitnessAdapter } from "./witness";

export type { SketchStore } from "./recipients";
export type { HeadPass } from "./head";
export type { WitnessAdapter } from "./witness";
export { publicTransparency } from "./editions";
export { headValue, publicHead } from "./head";
export { isReadRoute, sketchKeys } from "./recipients";
export { witnessFrom } from "./witness";

/**
 * What the auth module needs from this one (section 5, `auth.onSeen`): resolveSession calls `seen` when a session
 * resolved and `seenSignedOut` for a GET when none did. Both return at once; neither throws, and a failure of Valkey is
 * swallowed: counting never fails or slows a request.
 */
export type TransparencyForAuth = RecipientCounter;

/** The job's name: its lock is `job:transparency`, and its log lines carry it. */
export const TRANSPARENCY_JOB = "transparency";
/** Ten minutes between the end of one round and the start of the next (7.14). */
export const TRANSPARENCY_ROUND_MS = 10 * 60_000;

export interface CreateTransparencyOptions {
  apiDb: Db;
  /**
   * The counts store (3d review H3): a Valkey of its own that writes nothing to disk (COUNTS_URL, Compose's `counts`),
   * for the sketches and the salt alone. Never the shared one, whose append-only file would keep the salt and every
   * value added to a sketch.
   */
  counts: SketchStore;
  /** The auth module's one sender this module needs: the keeper's daily mail to HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL (section 5). */
  auth: AuthForTransparency;
  config: Pick<
    Config,
    "EDGE_PURGE" | "RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT" | "MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR" | "HEAD_WITNESS" | "HEAD_WITNESS_URL" | "APP_SITE" | "R1_CLASSIFIER" | "AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1" | "AUTOMATION_DPIA_R1_ACTS"
  > &
    Partial<Pick<Config, "HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL">>;
  logger: Logger;
  /** The clock of the counts and of the job's rounds; tests move it. The head's day is the database's own. */
  now?: () => Date;
  /** The head's witness in place of the one HEAD_WITNESS names; for tests (fakeWitness() is no https address). */
  witness?: WitnessAdapter;
  /** The repository in place of the one over apiDb; for tests (3d review M11: an edition that fails). */
  repo?: TransparencyRepo;
}

/**
 * What one round of the job did: the months it closed, the editions it published once a day, and the head's pass, null
 * when the round ran none (before the dispatch hour, or once the day's value needs nothing more).
 */
export interface TransparencyRound {
  months: string[];
  editions: { year: number; version: number }[] | null;
  head: HeadPass | null;
}

export function createTransparency(options: CreateTransparencyOptions) {
  const now = options.now ?? (() => new Date());
  const log = options.logger;
  const repo = options.repo ?? createTransparencyRepo(options.apiDb);
  const signedOut = options.config.RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT === "on";
  const forAuth: TransparencyForAuth = createRecipientCounter({ store: options.counts, signedOut, log, now });
  // HEAD_WITNESS's adapter; the configuration refused a test adapter on an open site, and the builder refuses it again.
  const witness = options.witness ?? witnessFrom(options.config);
  // 3d review M13: whether a keeper's address is set, so a mail that did not go is owed and retried, and alerted after the day.
  const keeper = options.config.HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL !== undefined && options.config.HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL !== "";
  const head = { repo, witness, mailKeeper: options.auth.mailKeeper, log, keeper };
  // The UTC day of this process's last daily pass of the editions: one a day, after the dispatch hour. A restart runs it
  // again, which the editions' key makes harmless.
  let lastDaily: string | null = null;
  // The day whose first head pass ran (it alone looks for a missed day before), and the day whose value needs nothing
  // more: published, and witnessed or never to be. Until then each round passes again, so a witness that did not answer
  // is asked again in the day's later rounds.
  let headFirst: string | null = null;
  let headDone: string | null = null;

  async function round(): Promise<TransparencyRound> {
    const at = now();
    // 3d review M11: each part of the round in a try of its own, with its own log line, so a counts store that is down or
    // an edition that keeps failing never keeps the day's head value from being published, mailed and alerted on.
    let months: string[] = [];
    try {
      // 3d review M10: the running month's mark, set once, before the close of the months before.
      await markMonth(options.counts, at);
      months = await closeMonths({ store: options.counts, repo, signedOut }, at);
      if (months.length > 0) log.info({ job: TRANSPARENCY_JOB, months }, "transparency: the recipients' months were stored");
    } catch (err) {
      log.error({ err, job: TRANSPARENCY_JOB }, "transparency: the recipients' months were not closed; the next round tries again");
    }
    const day = at.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    if (at.getUTCHours() < options.config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR) return { months, editions: null, head: null };
    let editions: TransparencyRound["editions"] = null;
    if (lastDaily !== day) {
      try {
        editions = (await publishEditions({ repo, log }, at)).published;
        lastDaily = day;
      } catch (err) {
        // lastDaily stays as it was: the next round asks again, as every round does until the editions pass once.
        log.error({ err, job: TRANSPARENCY_JOB }, "transparency: the editions were not published; the next round asks again");
      }
    }
    // After the editions, so the day's value covers an edition's audit row written in the same round.
    let pass: HeadPass | null = null;
    if (headDone !== day) {
      try {
        pass = await publishHead(head, { firstOfDay: headFirst !== day });
        headFirst = day;
        if (pass.done) headDone = day;
      } catch (err) {
        log.error({ err, job: TRANSPARENCY_JOB }, "transparency: the head's daily pass failed; the next round passes again");
      }
    }
    return { months, editions, head: pass };
  }

  return {
    /** The interface the auth module calls, registered with auth.onSeen in index.ts. */
    forAuth,
    /** The three public routes, mounted by app.ts at /api before the session's resolution. */
    routes: transparencyRoutes({ repo, facts: publicFacts(options.config) }),
    /** One round of the job, as the timer runs it; for tests. */
    round,
    /** Starts the job `transparency` and returns the function that stops it. */
    startJobs: (lock: JobLock) => createJob({ name: TRANSPARENCY_JOB, intervalMs: TRANSPARENCY_ROUND_MS, lockTtlMs: TRANSPARENCY_ROUND_MS * 2, lock, log, run: round }).start(),
  };
}

export type Transparency = ReturnType<typeof createTransparency>;
```
